category_note.risky_savings: The expense side (527) is tracked. If you post other payroll items to 527 as well, separate the contribution with an analytical account (e.g. 527.100).
category_note.non_monetary_neutral: An informational row, not a difference. Non-monetary benefits (typically 1 % of the vehicle purchase price) are not posted separately — the expense is already in the books from the source document, so they are excluded from the gross wages being compared.
category_note.partner_settlement: An offset pays out nothing — it only reclassifies the liability (331/366 debit / 365 credit). The Net pay category is lower by this amount and the payments column stays empty.
category_note.tax_bonus_receivable: An informational row, not a difference. Tax bonuses paid out exceeded the advance tax due; the excess reduces future remittances or is refunded on request (Sec. 35d(5)). The Income tax category already accounts for it.
category_note.unposted_liabilities: An informational row, not a difference. Employer liability insurance and benefits are paid from payroll but posted from their own document — the payroll bridge does not post them, so there is nothing to compare.

annual_settlement.deadlines: The employee may ask by {request} at the latest, and must hand over certificates from previous employers by the same day. You perform the settlement by {settlement} and return any overpayment with the {payout} payroll at the latest.
annual_settlement.load_failed: The annual settlement could not be loaded.
annual_settlement.empty_title: Nobody has asked for an annual settlement for this year yet
annual_settlement.empty_description: Once an employee asks, record the request and the documents they provided. Without them the settlement is not performed.
annual_settlement.no_employees_title: This company has no employees yet
annual_settlement.no_employees_description: The annual settlement is computed from approved payroll, so people and monthly payroll runs come first.
annual_settlement.select_employee: Pick an employee and record what they provided.
annual_settlement.request_status: The employee asked for an annual settlement
annual_settlement.request_evidence_placeholder: Optionally, the received request number or a file reference…
annual_settlement.filing_obligation: Files or must file a tax return
annual_settlement.filing_obligation_reason_placeholder: For example self-employment income above CZK 20,000…
annual_settlement.annual_claims: Claims items that can only be applied annually
annual_settlement.annual_claims_hint: Gifts, mortgage interest, pension and life insurance, the spouse credit or the halted-enforcement credit. The application cannot compute these yet.
annual_settlement.other_caregiver_status: Did another person in the shared household claim the child in any month?
annual_settlement.other_caregiver_hint: This is required for the annual JMHZ filing. If Yes, enter the person and the exact months in which they claimed the child.
annual_settlement.request_saved: The annual settlement documents are saved.
annual_settlement.request_save_failed: The documents could not be saved.
annual_settlement.certificates_hint: The law requires a document from every previous employer covering the payroll settled, the advances withheld, the monthly tax credits granted and the monthly tax bonuses paid out. An empty field means "the certificate does not state it" and stops the settlement; zero means "the certificate states zero" and is used in the calculation.
annual_settlement.certificates_empty: No certificate from another employer has been entered for this year.
annual_settlement.certificate_employment_period_hint: The period stated on the form. It reveals concurrent payers: if two periods overlap, the taxpayer drew wages simultaneously, the annual settlement cannot be performed and they must file a tax return (§ 38g(2)). An empty period means "unknown", not "there was no overlap" — older certificates do not carry it.
annual_settlement.certificate_missing: The certificate is missing: {fields}. The annual settlement will not run until these are filled in.
annual_settlement.certificates_saved: The certificates from other payers are saved.
annual_settlement.certificates_save_failed: The certificates could not be saved.
annual_settlement.request_conflict: Somebody else changed the documents in the meantime. Reload them and repeat your change.
annual_settlement.preview_failed: The annual settlement calculation could not be loaded.
annual_settlement.settled: The annual settlement is done and the document is ready to download.
annual_settlement.settle_failed: The annual settlement could not be performed.
annual_settlement.settle_refused: We did not perform the annual settlement. Below you can see what is missing.
annual_settlement.already_settled: The annual settlement for {year} was performed on {date}.
annual_settlement.payout_note: The overpayment is returned through payroll — with the {payout} payroll at the latest. It enters the nearest payroll run within that deadline automatically.
annual_settlement.paid_out_note: The overpayment was paid out with the {period} payroll.
annual_settlement.pending_payout_note: The overpayment has not been paid out yet. It is returned in the nearest payroll run, in March at the latest.
annual_settlement.no_payout_note: Nothing is paid out. An underpayment from the annual settlement is never withheld from the employee.
annual_settlement.below_threshold_note: The settlement was performed, but by law an overpayment of up to {threshold} is not paid out.
annual_settlement.bonus_threshold_met: Bonus-qualifying annual income of {income} reached the {threshold} threshold; the annual bonus itself must be at least {minimum}.
annual_settlement.bonus_threshold_not_met: No annual bonus arose: income of {income} did not reach the annual threshold of {threshold}.

bonus_eligibility.eligible: The annual bonus is eligible: income of {income} reached {threshold} and the calculated bonus of {candidate} reached the {minimum} minimum.
bonus_eligibility.income_below_threshold: No annual bonus arose: income of {income} did not reach the annual threshold of {threshold}.
bonus_eligibility.amount_below_threshold: The annual bonus is zero: the calculated amount of {candidate} did not reach the {minimum} minimum even though the income threshold was met.

annual_settlement.bonus_threshold_hint: The annual calculation reassesses every eligible month. It can therefore catch up the bonus for months in which the monthly income threshold was not met.

prior_employers_options.none: They had no other employer this year

blocker.not_requested: The employee did not ask for an annual settlement, or we have no record of it. Without a request no settlement is performed and the tax is settled by the advances withheld.
blocker.requested_after_deadline: The request arrived after 15 February. After that day the employer can no longer perform the annual settlement.
blocker.declaration_not_signed: The employee did not sign a taxpayer declaration with you for this year. Without it no credits are applied, monthly or annually.
blocker.declaration_unverified: The taxpayer declaration has no supporting evidence. Add it on the employee card.
blocker.prior_employer_documents_missing: Certificates from previous employers for this year are missing. The law does not allow a settlement without them.
blocker.prior_employer_documents_late: Certificates from previous employers arrived after 15 February.
blocker.must_file_tax_return: The employee files their own tax return. The employer must not perform an annual settlement for them.
blocker.filing_obligation_unknown: We do not know whether the employee files a tax return. Answer this — it decides whether a settlement is possible at all.
blocker.annual_only_claims_unsupported: The employee claims deductions or credits the application cannot compute yet. The settlement has to be done outside the application, or the employee files their own return.
blocker.annual_only_claims_unknown: We do not know whether the employee claims deductions or credits that apply only annually.
blocker.external_certificate_unverified: The certificate from a previous employer has no supporting evidence. Only an evidenced document may enter the whole-year total.
blocker.external_certificate_incomplete: The certificate from a previous employer is missing one of the figures the law requires. Fill them in under Certificate from another payer — until then the application will not guess them, because an incomplete total would produce an overpayment the employee is not entitled to.
blocker.accumulator_missing: The annual tax accumulation for this year is missing. Check the employee's opening balances and approved payroll.
blocker.no_approved_months: The employee has no approved month in this year, so there is nothing to settle.
blocker.settlement_deadline_passed: 31 March has passed — the day by which the employer performs the annual settlement.
blocker.non_resident: The employee is not a documented Czech tax resident. Employers do not perform an annual settlement for them.
blocker.credit_evidence_unverified: A tax credit claim has no supporting evidence, or the documented claims contradict each other.
blocker.child_evidence_unverified: A child tax benefit claim has no supporting evidence.
blocker.child_claim_conflict: The child claims contradict each other — check the child order, the shared-household confirmation and the exclusion of the other taxpayer.
blocker.child_jmhz_evidence_incomplete: Complete the child's name and date of birth on the child card, then state in the annual settlement documents whether another person in the shared household claimed the child.
blocker.already_settled: The annual settlement for this year has already been performed. It is done once a year.
blocker.ruleset_year_not_covered: We have no effective tax rules covering the whole of this year, so annual amounts cannot be derived.
blocker.tax_year_not_finished: The tax year has not ended yet. The annual settlement can only be performed from 1 January of the following year.
blocker.taxpayer_credit_evidence_missing: The employee has signed the taxpayer declaration, but the basic taxpayer credit is missing from their claim records. Add it on the employee card — without it the settlement would compute the tax without the annual credit.

grid.title: Monthly attendance grid
grid.subtitle: One row per employee, one column per day. Type the hours worked into a cell — “8”, “8:30” or “7.5” all work. Exceptions (shifts across midnight, breaks, surcharge categories) stay in the row editor above.
grid.hours_hint: The record starts at the given time and lasts the entered hours plus the break. Cells hold net worked time.
grid.flag_notice: Night work, weekend, public holiday and difficult environment are flags over THE SAME hours, not extra hours. They are never added to time worked — that is always regular work plus overtime.
grid.month_approved: The month is approved, nothing can be written to it.
grid.saved_partially: Days saved: {saved}. Not saved: {failed} — they stay in the grid with the reason on the cell.
grid.save_failed: The grid could not be saved.
grid.filled: Days filled: {count}. Only empty cells were touched.
grid.filled_without_calendar: Days filled: {count}. {people} employments have no work calendar, so Monday to Friday at eight hours was assumed — such an estimate does not know about public holidays.
grid.copied: Days copied: {count} for {people} employees from {period}. Employees not found: {missing}. Days that do not fit this month: {skipped}.
grid.copy_failed: The previous month could not be loaded.
grid.keyboard_hint: Tab and arrows move around the grid, Enter jumps one row down, Ctrl+Enter saves.
grid.mobile_note: The monthly grid needs a tablet or wider — on a phone a cell would be narrower than a finger. Use the row entry below, or the import.
grid.blocked_no_permission: You are not allowed to write attendance.
grid.blocked_nothing_changed: Nothing has changed yet. Type hours into a cell, or use a bulk action above the grid.
grid.blocked_flag_category: Bulk filling only makes sense for regular work and overtime. Flags (night, weekend, holiday, difficult environment) are entered on specific days.

problems.unparsable: The hours cannot be read. Write them as “8”, “8:30” or “7.5”.
problems.delete_unsupported: The grid does not delete records — deletion is a revision with a reason. Use the row editor.
problems.locked: The day holds several records of the same category, so one number cannot replace them. Edit it in the row editor.
problems.crosses_midnight: The day would run past midnight. Enter a shift across midnight in the row editor.
problems.invalid_wall_time: That time does not exist on this day (daylight saving change). Enter the day in the row editor.

approve_errors.holiday_arrangement_missing: The month contains work on a public holiday, but {name} has no agreed arrangement (time off in lieu, or a surcharge). Pay cannot be calculated without it, so approval stops here.
approve_errors.difficulty_factors_missing: The month contains work in a difficult environment, but {name} has no count of aggravating factors under § 117.
approve_errors.average_earning_missing: The surcharge for {name} is calculated from average earnings, and none is established for this period.
approve_errors.inputs_locked: Period inputs are locked by a payroll run, so approving attendance cannot write surcharges into them.
approve_errors.overtime_conflict: Overtime for {name} is entered twice — in attendance and in quick inputs. Keep only one record.

overtime.title: Overtime — Section 93 Labour Code limits
overtime.consent_missing: No consent to overtime beyond the ordered limit is on record.
overtime.consent_open: Overtime consent on record from {from}, open-ended.
overtime.consent_until: Overtime consent on record from {from} to {to}.
overtime.consent_hint: Beyond the ordered limit (8 hours per week and 150 hours per year) overtime may only be required by agreement with the employee — Section 93(3) of the Labour Code. Record the date the agreement takes effect; without it all recorded overtime is measured against the ordered-overtime limits.
overtime.consent_failed: Overtime consent could not be saved.
overtime.consent_blocked_no_date: Fill in the date the agreement takes effect.
overtime.prefilled_date: Prefilled with the first day of the month on screen. Days before this date count as ordered overtime (8 h/week, 150 h/year).
overtime.prefilled_date_other_month: Prefilled with the first day of the browsed month {period}, not the date on the paperwork. Days before this date count as ordered overtime (8 h/week, 150 h/year) — correct the date when recording retroactively.
overtime.prohibition_banner: The recorded overtime breaches a statutory overtime ban. The payroll run cannot be approved until the finding is overridden with a reason.

compensatory_check.absence_without_compensation: Compensatory time off is recorded for this month, but no overtime record it offsets — the Section 93(5) exclusion will not apply.
compensatory_check.compensation_without_absence: Granted compensatory time off is recorded for this month, but attendance has no matching absence — payroll does not know about the time off.
compensatory_check.grant_date_unknown: Some compensatory time off has no grant date, so it cannot be assigned to a month.

overtime.averaging_hint: Total overtime must not exceed an average of 8 hours per week over an averaging period of at most 26 consecutive weeks. Only a collective agreement may extend it, to at most 52 weeks, so an extension requires a reference to that agreement. Without a setting, the statutory 26 weeks apply.
overtime.averaging_saved: The averaging period has been saved.
overtime.averaging_failed: The averaging period could not be saved.
overtime.averaging_load_failed: Existing averaging periods could not be loaded.
overtime.averaging_blocked_no_date: Enter the date the setting takes effect.
overtime.averaging_blocked_no_weeks: Enter the length in whole weeks.
overtime.averaging_blocked_statutory_max: Without a collective agreement the period may be at most 26 weeks (Section 93(4)).
overtime.averaging_blocked_collective_max: Not even a collective agreement may set a period longer than 52 weeks (Section 93(4)).
overtime.averaging_blocked_no_reference: Name the collective agreement that sets the longer period.
overtime.protection_hint: A pregnant employee must not work overtime at all; an employee caring for a child under one year of age may not be ordered to work overtime, although it may be agreed. Being a minor is not recorded here — it follows from the date of birth (Sections 245(1) and 350(2)).
overtime.protection_child_under_one: Caring for a child under one — overtime cannot be ordered
overtime.protection_saved: The overtime ban has been saved.
overtime.protection_failed: The overtime ban could not be saved.
overtime.protection_blocked_no_date: Enter the date the protection takes effect.
overtime.compensation_hint: Overtime compensated by time off is excluded from the averaging period under Section 93(4). What matters is the date the overtime fell on, not the day the employee took the time off. The entry does not affect the ordered-overtime limits under Section 93(2).
overtime.compensation_granted_on: Day the time off was taken
overtime.compensation_saved: The compensatory time off has been saved.
overtime.compensation_failed: The compensatory time off could not be saved.
overtime.compensation_blocked_no_date: Enter the date the overtime fell on.
overtime.compensation_blocked_no_minutes: Enter the length of the compensatory time off in whole minutes.

people.other_withholding_eligibility_label: Sickness insurance participation from this remuneration
people.other_withholding_eligibility_hint: Decides how the income is taxed without a signed tax declaration (Income Tax Act, § 6 (4)(b)). If the agreed remuneration establishes sickness insurance participation, tax advance applies every month. If it does not, months where the remuneration stays below the decisive amount (CZK 4,500 in 2026) are taxed by 15 % withholding tax and the rest by tax advance. Until this is answered, the statutory calculation ends in manual review.
people.tax_declaration_hint: It is kept in the person's statutory evidence, not on the relationship — it can be signed or withdrawn at any time, so the value is only mirrored here. It decides the monthly taxpayer credit (Income Tax Act, § 35ba and § 38k (4)).

people.social_part_time_discount_notified_on_hi: Under Section 7a(5) the discount is only due if the intent to apply it was notified to the Czech Social Security Administration no later than when it is applied. This field no longer establishes the entitlement - since the intent register was introduced (Filings → Discount intent) the accepted OZUSPOJ notification decides. surcharge_policy.title: Statutory surcharge policy (Sections 114–118)
surcharge_policy.hint: What is agreed for this employment relation beyond the statutory minimum. Without an agreement the statutory default applies — and a month with work on a public holiday or in a difficult environment cannot be approved.

surcharge_policy.conflict_error: Someone else changed the policy in the meantime. The current state has been reloaded — check it and save again.

surcharge_policy.statutory_title: What applies without an agreed policy
surcharge_policy.statutory_holiday_hint: For a public holiday the law grants compensatory time off (Section 115(1)) unless agreed otherwise, not a surcharge. Until something else is agreed, a month with holiday work does not pass attendance approval.
surcharge_policy.new_hint: A policy is never rewritten — a new version is created next to the old one and the history stays readable.
surcharge_policy.valid_from_required: Fill in the date from which the new policy version applies.
surcharge_policy.valid_from_locked: A correction never moves the effective date — it is the boundary against the previous version, whose end is derived from it.
surcharge_policy.valid_to_hint: Optional. Filling it in closes the policy; from the next day the statutory default applies, so compensatory time off for holidays and a missing basis for a difficult environment.
surcharge_policy.valid_to_invalid: The end of validity cannot precede the start of the policy.
surcharge_policy.holiday_mode_hint: A wage agreed with regard to holiday work does not exist — Section 114(3) covers overtime only.
surcharge_policy.factors_hint: 1 to 255. Without a documented count the difficult environment surcharge is not calculated and the month does not pass approval.
surcharge_policy.factors_invalid: Enter the number of aggravating factors between 1 and 255, or leave the field empty.
surcharge_policy.rates_hint: Enter percentages. An empty field means the statutory minimum is used.
surcharge_policy.lower_allowed: a lower rate may be agreed
surcharge_policy.lower_forbidden: a lower rate cannot be agreed

submissions.title: Payroll submissions
submissions.subtitle: Prepare, verify and download statutory reports with clearly separated test and production environments.
submissions.other_fail_closed: Obligations whose agenda the system does not recognise — typically recorded manually or coming from an older version. They stay visible here so they cannot get lost; the system offers neither preparation nor submission for them.
submissions.jmhz_fail_closed: Prepare JMHZ from an approved immutable revision and, after a validation dry run, submit it through ISDS or VREP. Production filing becomes available when the statutory window opens.
submissions.health_fail_closed: Direct health-insurer submissions are not available yet. The system will not mark them as sent or accepted without a verified channel and receipt.

statutory.title: Sickness and other statutory obligations
statutory.description: A truthful capability matrix for the selected period. NEMPRI and HZUPN currently require a manual official-channel workflow; MyÚčto only preserves an immutable link to a real DMS receipt. Nothing is transmitted here.
statutory.error: The statutory-obligation overview could not be loaded or saved.
statutory.saved: The manual-completion evidence was stored immutably.

agenda.NEMPRI: Employer notice of an employee benefit claim
agenda.HZUPN: Employer report at the end of incapacity
agenda.OZUSPOJ: Notice of intent to claim the insurance discount

reason.nempri_legacy_variant_not_supported: The pre-2025 NEMPRI variant is not supported by this workflow. Use the period-specific procedure and do not mark anything as fulfilled here.
reason.nempri_only_partially_in_jmhz: JMHZ only absorbed part of the data. NEMPRI remains a separate action and must not be switched off automatically.
reason.nempri_standalone_manual: NEMPRI is a standalone obligation for this period. An accountant must complete both its content and submission in an official channel.
reason.hzupn_remains_standalone: HZUPN remains a standalone report alongside JMHZ. MyÚčto neither generates nor transmits its data message.
reason.eldp_historic_preparation_available: A historic ELDP can be prepared on its dedicated tab. This overview does not duplicate its data or status.
reason.eldp_jmhz_default_on_demand_exception: From 2026, ordinary ELDP data comes from JMHZ, but historic and on-demand scenarios remain. Preparation is available on the dedicated tab.
reason.accident_insurance_calculation_output_li: Assessment-base and rate calculation, assessment, output and payment liability for statutory accident insurance are not implemented. JMHZ does not replace the obligation. MyÚčto can only preserve evidence of an externally verified amount and an actually completed payment.

workflow.verify_case_and_source_data: Verify the specific case, relevant period and source data, including earnings and shifts, outside this P0 overview.
workflow.submit_in_official_channel: Complete and submit the report through a verified official ČSSZ channel.
workflow.store_official_receipt_in_company_dms: Store the real receipt or protocol as a company-scoped DMS document.
workflow.record_receipt_evidence: Only then record the reference and DMS document below as evidence of manual completion.
workflow.use_eldp_workspace: Use the dedicated Pension record sheet tab; preparation never implies that the form was submitted.
workflow.calculate_accident_insurance_externally: Determine the period, assessment base, rate and amount from professionally verified external sources; MyÚčto neither calculates nor validates them.
workflow.pay_accident_insurance_externally: Make the actual payment outside MyÚčto and verify both its amount and the payee identification.
workflow.store_payment_evidence_in_company_dms: Store the payment confirmation or a specific official document as a company-scoped DMS document.
workflow.record_payment_evidence: Only then record the amount, references and DMS document as immutable manual-completion evidence.

form.title: Manual-completion evidence — {agenda}
form.description: The record is append-only. Corrections are added as new evidence; the original is neither edited nor deleted.
form.document_hint: The server accepts only an active company-scoped document owned by this tenant and freezes its SHA-256 itself.
form.confirmation: I confirm that the submission was actually completed in an official external channel and the specified company DMS document is its real receipt or protocol.
form.payment_confirmation: I confirm that the amount was determined using a professionally verified external procedure, actually paid, and the specified company DMS document is its payment confirmation or a specific official document. MyÚčto did not verify the calculation or payment.

evidence.title: Stored evidence
evidence.description: Immutable records separated by tenant, environment and period.
evidence.empty: No evidence is stored for this period and environment.

transport.title: Sent submissions and their status
transport.description: Every dispatch attempt to ČSSZ, newest first. Sending happens when a submission is frozen — this screen tracks the status and fetches the result.
transport.load_failed: The dispatch history could not be loaded.
transport.state_unknown: Until the request succeeds the system does not know what was sent — please do not read this empty screen as proof that nothing went out.

environment.label: Environment
environment.production_note: Live submissions to ČSSZ. What is in this list counts towards the authority.
environment.test_note: ČSSZ test environment. A submission made here does not discharge the obligation.

vs.label: Employer variable symbol
vs.hint: The VREP gateway identifies the submission by the employer's variable symbol — without it the status cannot be fetched and the transaction cannot be closed. You will find it on the ČSSZ registration decision.
vs.missing: No active workplace in the employer settings has a social-security variable symbol filled in. Add it in the settings, or type it here manually.
vs.required: Enter the variable symbol (at most ten digits) so the status can be fetched or the transaction closed.

empty.title: Nothing has been sent yet
empty.description: No dispatch attempt has been made in this environment yet. Submissions are sent after freezing on the JMHZ tab.
empty.import_hint: If you filed in this environment using other software, import the processing protocol from your data box — the overview will then show it next to submissions sent from here.

imported.action: Import protocol from the data box
imported.hint: This overview does not know about submissions filed by other software. The processing protocol delivered by ČSSZ to your data box can be imported here as XML, so filings made outside the app show up as well. A protocol issued to another variable symbol is refused.
imported.added: The protocol was imported. Submission status: {status}.
imported.replaced: This protocol had already been imported — the record was updated, no duplicate was created.
imported.failed: The protocol could not be imported.
imported.note: This document arrived through the data box; the app did not send it. It therefore holds no submission payload — the status cannot be polled and no transaction can be closed. The protocol itself is the result.
imported.guid_missing: The protocol states no submission ID
imported.detail_unavailable: The stored original could not be re-read, so error detail is unavailable here. The protocol reports {total} error(s).
imported.errors_failed: The protocol errors could not be loaded.

ready.title: Prepared submissions are waiting to be sent
ready.description: These exact submissions have already been frozen but have no dispatch attempt yet. Send them directly from here by their submission number — the application will not look up another submission for the same period.
ready.user_action_note: Nothing is sent automatically. You start every dispatch with this button; for ISDS you then explicitly confirm sign-in and sending.
ready.vrep_started: Submission no. {id} was handed to the VREP gateway. Follow the result in the history below.
ready.isds_queued: The submission was prepared in the ISDS outbox as message no. {id}.
ready.isds_already_queued: The submission is already in the ISDS outbox as message no. {id}; no duplicate message was created.
ready.outbox: ISDS outgoing message no. {id} is prepared. Your sign-in and confirmation are still required before sending.
ready.existing_outbox: This submission is already in the ISDS outbox as message no. {id} — status: {state}. Another dispatch is blocked to prevent a duplicate.
ready.gateway_start_failed: The message is safely stored in the outbox, but ISDS sign-in could not be started. Open outgoing submissions and try signing in again.
ready.dispatch_failed: The prepared submission could not be handed over for dispatch.

transport.awaiting_note: ČSSZ confirmed receipt of the message, not acceptance of the submission — only the processing protocol decides the result. Fetch the status; until then do not close the transaction or the result would be lost.
transport.poll_failed: The submission status could not be fetched.
transport.poll_inconclusive: ČSSZ has returned neither a receipt confirmation nor a protocol yet. Please try again in a moment.
transport.close_failed: The transaction could not be closed.
transport.closed: The transaction of attempt no. {id} has been closed.
transport.close_note: The protocol has been retrieved, so the transaction can be closed. The ČSSZ submission protocol requires closing it.
transport.acknowledged: ČSSZ confirmed receipt, processing is running. Recommended delay before the next query: {seconds} s.

report.control_unknown: Our catalog does not know this control — the message is therefore shown exactly as it arrived from ČSSZ.

automation.title: Protocol retrieval in the background
automation.description: The application asks ČSSZ for the result on its own and closes the transaction once the protocol arrives. The buttons below are here for when you need to step in sooner.
automation.next_poll: The next check is scheduled for {at}.
automation.next_poll_unknown: The next check will run on the next background pass.
automation.last_error: The last check failed: {message} The application will try again.
automation.closed: The transaction at ČSSZ is closed ({at}).
automation.close_pending: The transaction at ČSSZ is not closed yet; the application will try on its own.
automation.close_error: Closing the transaction failed: {message} Try closing it with the button.
automation.expired_note: The application stopped asking. Check the submission on the ČSSZ ePortal or in your data box and load the protocol using “Load protocol”.

transport.closed_already: This message's transaction was already closed.

storno.confirm_title: Really cancel the whole report for {period}?
storno.confirm_text: A cancellation voids ALL reports filed at ČSSZ for this period, not just the last one sent. It can only be filed until the 20th of the following month; after that only an amendment will do.

storno.already: A cancellation for this report already exists — it is submission no. {id}.
storno.failed: The cancellation could not be prepared.
storno.unavailable: Only a report already sent to ČSSZ can be cancelled.

certificate.subject: Issued to

certificate.serial_decimal: Serial number (decimal, as on the ČSSZ form)

serial.label: Serial number registered with ČSSZ

eldp.intro: The record sheet is no longer an annual duty. From 2026 the employer neither draws it up nor files it — pension insurance data is reported in the single monthly employer report and the Czech Social Security Administration assembles the sheet from it; employees can see it on the ČSSZ ePortal. Here you prepare one only in three exceptions:

exceptions.beforeTwentySix: For periods before 1 January 2026, governed by the earlier wording of the Act.
exceptions.endedBeforeApril: For employment ended before 1 April 2026, covered by the transitional provision.
exceptions.authorityRequest: On request from ČSSZ/ÚSSZ under Section 38a(2) and (3) — when the deadline for the monthly or corrective report has passed, or the record sheet cannot be assembled from the reported data.

accounting_row_hint.withholding_tax: Tax at a special rate under § 6(4) of the Income Tax Act (small agreements without a taxpayer declaration). It is remitted by a separate payment (account prefix 7720 instead of 7704), on a different due date and reported separately, so a shared account merges both liabilities and the balance can no longer be matched against the payments. Tax bonuses and annual settlement refunds belong to the ADVANCE tax account, not here.
accounting_row_hint.risky_savings: Statutory employer contribution to retirement savings for risk work (4% of the assessment base from 1 January 2026). It is not paid to the employee but remitted to the pension company, so it is a statutory social expense (527) against other payables (379), not insurance on 336.
accounting_row_hint.employee_receivable: Where a negative net wage is reclassified — typically health insurance topped up to the minimum assessment base in a month with no cash income. The employee owes the employer, so this is a receivable (335), not a payable.
accounting_row_hint.non_deductible_benefit: The tax-exempt part of a non-cash benefit (recreation, sport, culture, health care, printed books). Under Section 25(1)(h) of the Income Tax Act it is precisely the EXEMPT part that is non-deductible; the part above the cap is taxed at the employee and stays deductible. Account 528 flows automatically into non-deductible expenses in the corporate income tax return.
accounting_row_hint.travel_expense: A travel allowance reimburses an expense under Part Seven of the Labour Code; it is not remuneration for work and does not belong in wage expenses. The contra account stays the payable account of the employment relationship, because the allowance is paid together with the wage.

retention.title: Payroll data retention periods
retention.subtitle: How long each group of payroll data is kept, when the period starts and where it is written down.
retention.explainer_title: An elapsed period ends the duty to keep the data; it is not an order to destroy it.
retention.explainer_body: Nothing is deleted here. Two things can be set: the company deviation from the catalogue period (upwards only) and a legal hold on a specific person. Erasure of personal data itself is a separate proposal that somebody has to approve, carried out in a second step on its own screen. For each person the longest period across all applicable categories wins.

erasure.title: Erasure of personal data
erasure.subtitle: Proposal, approval and execution of erasure for people whose retention period has elapsed.
erasure.explainer_title: Erasure is irreversible. The data cannot be re-entered.
erasure.explainer_body: The server builds the proposal only from people whose period has elapsed and who are not held. Approval and execution are two separate steps, so erasure cannot be triggered by a single click. Every item is assessed again before execution — anything that meanwhile received a hold is skipped.
erasure.explainer_audit: The audit trail of the erasure (who, when, under which period and about whom) stays even after execution. Personal data inside frozen content — issued PDFs, submitted XML — is not rewritten; the proposal lists it as residue.

benefit_baskets.title: Benefit exemption baskets
benefit_baskets.subtitle_annual: How much of the annual limit under Section 6(9) of the Income Tax Act each employee has used up this year, and how much of it has already been taxed.
benefit_baskets.subtitle_monthly: How much each employee received in the month into baskets whose decisive period is the calendar month, and how much of it has already been taxed.
benefit_baskets.explainer_title: The limit is a shared basket, not a cap on one component
benefit_baskets.explainer_body: The act exempts benefits up to the limit in aggregate for the whole provision. The basket therefore adds up per person and employer — across concurrent employment relationships and across payroll components of the same basket. Benefits above the limit are not forbidden; only the excess is taxed and subject to contributions.
benefit_baskets.explainer_frozen: The exempt and above-limit parts are read frozen from the moment the input was approved, so they match the payslip. This overview does not recalculate them against today's rules.
benefit_baskets.explainer_monthly: The monthly tab shows baskets under Section 6(9)(b) and (i) of the Income Tax Act. For temporary accommodation the limit is monthly, so the monthly total can be measured against it. For the meal contribution, however, the act ties the limit to a SINGLE SHIFT — a monthly total cannot be compared with it, so this overview asserts no limit and no remainder for it.

discountIntents.intro: The employer discount for short working hours is reported in the monthly report, but the entitlement comes from a different filing: the notification of intent (OZUSPOJ). Without it the Czech Social Security Administration will not recognise the discount and the deducted premium becomes a debt. The discount is applied only once the intent carries the delivery date from the CSSA protocol.

sicknessCases.title: Sickness insurance benefit cases

For sickness benefit the data are sent without delay after the first 14 days of incapacity have elapsed. The case is therefore recorded on its own and its deadline is tracked even before anyone prepares a submission.

byFunction.title: Income statement — by function
byFunction.subtitle: Decree 500/2002 Coll., Annex 2 Part II (§ 39b)
byFunction.explainer_title: Why this statement needs your input
byFunction.explainer_body: Classification by nature can be derived from the account number; by function it cannot — costs are classified by the function they serve, and the account number does not carry that. The same Services account may be cost of sales at one company and administrative overhead at another. Until the mapping is complete the statement will NOT be produced — an unassigned cost would silently drop out and overstate both gross profit and the result.
byFunction.incomplete_title: The statement cannot be produced yet

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.subtitle: § 31/§ 32 of the Accounting Act, § 35a VAT Act — retention periods for accounting and tax records and disposal holds
retention.explainer_body: An expired period means the OBLIGATION to retain has ended, not an instruction to shred. A hold under § 32 keeps records even after the period expires — use it during a tax audit, appeal or litigation; it cannot be placed without a documented file number or proceeding description.
retention.action_hold_hint: Places a hold under § 32 — records are kept even after the retention period expires.
retention.form_hint: Records of the selected period (or all) are held until you release the hold — typically after a tax audit or dispute ends.
retention.description_required: Fill in the file number or proceeding description.
retention.description_placeholder: File no. / proceeding description (e.g. tax audit, ref. no. …)
retention.release_confirm: Release this hold? After the periods expire, nothing will prevent disposal of the records.

transition.title: Transition bridge (§ 7b ↔ § 24 ITA)
transition.subtitle: Annexes 2 and 3 of the Income Tax Act — basis for the tax base adjustment when changing the accounting regime
transition.explainer_body: The report shows unpaid receivables and payables as of the transition date (payment status is reconstructed to that day, not today), advances received and paid, and an indicative stock value. The accountant enters the tax base adjustment into the return manually — the system does not apply anything on its own. Add valuables manually.
transition.not_applicable: The transition makes no sense for the selected direction — the company never used that regime.
transition.spread_annual: spread over {years} years: {amount} CZK per year
transition.receivables_title: Unpaid receivables as of the transition date
transition.payables_title: Unpaid payables as of the transition date

statement_notes.title: Notes to the financial statements
statement_notes.subtitle: § 18(1)(c) of the Accounting Act, § 39/39a/39b of Decree 500/2002 Coll. The set of sections depends on the entity category and statutory audit. Sections are stored per fiscal year — they can be completed even for a closed period.
statement_notes.complete: The notes are complete — all mandatory sections are filled in.
statement_notes.incomplete: The notes are incomplete — {filled} of {total} mandatory sections filled in.
statement_notes.auto_hint: The system prefills this section from its own data; your own text takes precedence and is never overwritten.
statement_notes.auto_placeholder: The system prefills this section automatically; you can refine it with your own text.
statement_notes.placeholder: Free-form text of the section — the system cannot derive it from the books.
statement_notes.readonly_hint: You do not have write permission — sections are read-only.

closing.title: Period closing
closing.abort_confirm: Really abort the closing and return the period to the Open state?
closing.precheck_empty: Checks have not run yet — start them with the button above.
closing.precheck_stale_hint: The check results are stale — data changed since they were saved (typically the previous period being closed). Run the precheck again; the errors shown below may no longer apply.

precheck.title: Pre-closing checks
precheck.description: Completeness checks before closing — drafts, unposted documents, technical account balances.

depreciation.title: Asset depreciation
depreciation.description: Booking of the year's accounting depreciation (Fixed assets module, CAS 013).

fx_revaluation.title: FX revaluation
fx_revaluation.description: Revaluation of foreign-currency receivables, payables and currency accounts at the CNB rate as of the balance sheet date (§24/6+7 Accounting Act, CAS 006) — accounts 563/663.

estimates.title: Estimated items
estimates.description: Estimated receivables and payables (388/389) — assisted manual entries as of the balance sheet date.

deferrals.title: Accruals & deferrals
deferrals.description: Prepaid and accrued items (381–385) — assisted manual entries as of the balance sheet date.

provisions.title: Receivable allowances
provisions.description: Allowances for overdue receivables (§8a/§8c Reserves Act) — proposed from the aging ledger, statutory allowance (558) and accounting allowance beyond it (559) against 391. Optional step.

income_tax.title: Income tax
income_tax.description: Booking of the income tax payable (591/341) as of the balance sheet date — amount from the finalized corporate income tax return / tax-base adjustments report. Optional step.

stock.title: Inventory
stock.description: Method B inventory closing (CAS 015) — posting the closing stock per stock records as of the balance sheet date (112/501, 132/504), reclassifying inventory shortages to 549 and surpluses to 648.

close_books.title: Close the books
close_books.description: Closing P&L accounts via 710 and balance sheet accounts via 702, determining the profit or loss (CAS 002).

open_next.title: Open the new year
open_next.description: Opening balance sheet accounts via 701 and transferring the profit or loss to 431 in the following period.

checks.prior_period_open: The previous period is not closed
checks.pl_balance_before_period: Non-zero expense/revenue balances before the period start
checks.drafts_in_period: Unposted journal drafts in the period
checks.journal_unbalanced: The period journal is not balanced (Σ Dr ≠ Σ Cr)
checks.unposted_invoices: Issued invoices of the period without a journal entry
checks.unposted_purchases: Received invoices of the period without a journal entry
checks.transit_261_open: Non-zero balance of 261 — Money in transit
checks.transit_261_documented: Balance of 261 is documented by {count} open transfers ({amount})
checks.acquisition_04x_open: Non-zero balances of 041/042 — assets under construction
checks.depreciation_missing: Assets in use without booked accounting depreciation for the year
checks.vat_period_entitlement: Entitlement to quarterly VAT period (§ 99a — prior-year turnover and registration year)
checks.income_tax_hint: Book the current income tax (591/341) via the Income tax closing step — CIT base report
checks.procurement_111_131_open: Non-zero balances of 111/131 — unsettled procurement of materials/goods
checks.accounts_unusual_side: Accounts with a balance on the unusual side (per account type)
checks.assets_without_accumulated_depreciation: Assets on an account without booked accumulated depreciation
checks.vat_343_vs_return: Account 343 balance vs. VAT return for the period
checks.vat_clearing_stale: VAT clearing does not match the period turnover
checks.deposits_314_324_open: Unsettled advance accounts 314/324 at the balance-sheet date
checks.paid_invoices_open_saldo: Paid issued invoices with an open balance on 311 (payment missing in the journal)
checks.paid_purchases_open_saldo: Paid purchase invoices with an open balance on 321 (payment missing in the journal)
checks.clearing_accounts_open: Clearing (suspense) accounts with an open balance at the balance-sheet date
checks.fx_footprint_missing: Foreign-currency lines on an FX account without a complete currency footprint (currency_code/amount_foreign)
checks.paid_proformas_no_advance: Paid proformas without a booked received advance on 324
checks.paid_advances_no_payment: Paid supplier advance invoices without a booked payment on 314
checks.settled_but_unpaid: Documents in the Sent state but with a payment already in the journal (update the status to Paid)
checks.cancelled_with_entry: Cancelled documents whose journal entry is still active (books and records contradict each other)
checks.entries_without_description: Posted journal entries with no description of the accounting case (§ 11(1)(b) of the Accounting Act) — add a description
checks.section18_statements_required: The entity category also requires a cash flow statement and a statement of changes in equity (§ 18(2) of the Accounting Act) — without them the financial statements are incomplete
checks.vat_registration_due: Turnover exceeded the VAT registration threshold (§ 6 VAT Act) — liability arises by law; check the date and file the registration
checks.vat_status_s79_missing: VAT payer status changed during the period without a line-45 deduction adjustment (§ 79 deduction claim on registration / § 79a deduction reduction on deregistration) — assess the business assets as of the transition date and record any items in the VAT corrections agenda
checks.estimates_unreleased: Estimated liabilities/assets carried from the previous period were not released (CAS 019) — the cost may be booked twice
checks.related_party_price_deviation: Prices charged to related parties differ from prices for unrelated ones (§ 36a VAT Act, § 23(7) Income Tax Act) — the difference must be documented
checks.related_party_transactions: Related-party transactions in the period — prices must match arm's-length prices (§ 36a VAT Act, § 23(7) Income Tax Act)
checks.realized_fx_unbooked: Realized FX difference not booked to 563/663 (settled foreign-currency document)
checks.small_asset_cards_incomplete: Small-asset cards do not match the 501.200 turnover (missing cards)
checks.cnb_rate_deviation: Document exchange rate deviates from the daily CNB rate
checks.payment_match_audit: Matched payments that don't add up (currency, amount, FX difference, counterparty)
checks.inventory_unresolved: Balance-sheet account stocktaking (§29–30 of the Accounting Act) is not completed or has unresolved differences

payment_match_audit.currency_mismatch: Payment currency does not match the document currency
payment_match_audit.fx_on_czk_czk: FX difference (563/663) booked on a CZK transaction against a CZK document
payment_match_audit.counterparty_mismatch: Payment counterparty does not match the document counterparty

closing.depreciation_hint: Verify that the year's accounting depreciation is booked (551 / accumulated depreciation).
closing.depreciation_not_applicable: There was no depreciable asset in this period — the step resolves itself and does not block closing the books.
closing.depreciation_link: Go to Fixed assets — Book depreciation
closing.depreciation_book_hint: Books accounting depreciation for every in-use asset card (551 / accumulated depreciation). Re-running overwrites the entries instead of duplicating them. Once the closing has started this is the only route — the Fixed assets module posts into an open period only.

fx.needs_closing: This step becomes available after the closing is started (Closing state).
fx.no_open_items: No open foreign-currency documents to revalue.
fx.bank_section: Foreign-currency bank accounts and cash desks
fx.no_bank_rows: No foreign-currency balances — add a row if you keep a currency account or cash desk.

assist.needs_closing: This step becomes available after the closing is started (Closing state).
assist.reverse_confirm: Really reverse entry #{id}? A mirror entry will be created.
assist.fields_required: Select a posting rule and fill in a positive amount and description.

small_asset.title: Small asset accrual
small_asset.hint: Small assets are not depreciated — the whole cost hits 501 in the year of acquisition. Deferring part of it to 381 is an optional accounting policy (Sec. 7 of the Accounting Act), not a legal rule. Pick a mode and the system proposes the deferral; it is released automatically in the next year.
small_asset.no_cards: There are no small asset cards to accrue in this period.
small_asset.posted: Small asset accrual has been posted.
small_asset.load_failed: Failed to load the accrual preview.
small_asset.materiality_hint: The flat rate is a policy only for an immaterial homogeneous set of small assets. Provide a documented materiality limit (base of 501 turnover); without it the flat rate cannot be used.
small_asset.materiality_required: For the flat rate, enter a positive materiality limit (base 501).
small_asset.materiality_missing: The flat rate requires a documented materiality limit — add one, or use pro-rata accrual.
small_asset.materiality_over: Base 501 ({base}) exceeds the materiality limit ({limit}) — the set is material, use pro-rata accrual.

prepaid_expense.title: Prepaid expenses (381)
prepaid_expense.hint: From received-invoice lines marked with a from–to period whose cost extends beyond year-end (insurance, parking, subscriptions). The system pro-rates by days the part belonging to future periods and defers it to 381 (Dr 381 / Cr expense account). Released automatically in N+1.
prepaid_expense.no_items: No invoice lines marked for time accrual in this period.
prepaid_expense.load_failed: Failed to load the accrual preview.

estimates.suggest_hint: The system finds recurring monthly costs (energy, rent, telco, cloud) whose invoice for the last month of the year is missing at the balance-sheet date, and proposes a passive estimate (389) equal to the average of the recent invoices. Review and confirm each proposal per vendor — the system never posts automatically.
estimates.none: No recurring cost with a missing invoice for the last month.

close.hint: Closes P&L accounts via 710 — Profit and loss account and balance sheet accounts via 702 — Final balance sheet account. Requires steps 1–5 completed and checks without errors.
close.blocked_precheck: The books cannot be closed yet — the pre-checks report an error: {checks}. Fix it and run the checks again in step 1.
close.blocked_steps: The books cannot be closed yet — one of the previous steps is neither confirmed nor skipped.
close.blocked_not_closing: The books can only be closed after the closing has started (Closing state).
close.confirm_text: Closing entries will be booked as of {date} (UZ document series) and period {year} will become Closed. The step can be undone until the financial statements are approved.
close.journal_link: Show closing entries in the journal
close.override_text: The period has unposted active documents. You may close the books over them only with a documented reason — the exception is recorded in the audit log and the closing package.
close.override_reason_ph: E.g. document delivered after closing, will be posted in the next period

open.hint: Books opening balances of balance sheet accounts via 701 — Opening balance sheet account into the following period (created automatically if missing) and transfers the profit or loss to 431.
open.confirm_text: The opening entry will be booked as of the first day of period {year} (OT document series).
open.done: The new year has been opened.
open.fx_reversal_note: If the reversal of receivable/payable revaluation is enabled in settings, a mirror FX entry is booked on the first day of the new period (KR document series).
open.fx_reversal_created: The revaluation reversal was booked on the first day of the period.

revert.confirm: Really undo this step? Its closing entries will be deleted (with an audit trail).

provisions.rule_hint: Statutory allowance proposal: §8c small receivables up to CZK 30,000 over 12 months → 100 %; §8a over 18 months → 50 %, over 30 months → 100 %. Adjust per receivable — the system never posts automatically.
provisions.time_barred_warning: The receivable may be time-barred — verify debt acknowledgement or suspension of the limitation period.
provisions.none: No overdue receivables to create allowances for.

income_tax.computed_from_ledger: Computed from the ledger (no finalized return) — verify before booking
income_tax.stock_pending: The inventory close (step 8) has not run yet. Under method B the closing stock is removed from expenses, so the tax base will still change — do not rely on this figure yet. Book the inventory first, then come back.
income_tax.no_return: No finalized CIT return for the year — enter the amount manually per the tax-base adjustments report.
income_tax.booked: Income tax payable has been booked.
income_tax.amount_required: Enter a positive income tax amount.
income_tax.not_applicable_fo: Personal income tax is not an expense of the accounting entity and is not posted to 591/341. Explicitly skip this step.

stock.needs_closing: This step becomes available once closing has started (status Closing).
stock.not_applicable: The company does not keep inventory under double-entry bookkeeping — the inventory step is skipped automatically and does not block closing the books.
stock.hint: Method B inventory closing (CAS 015): posts the closing stock per stock records as of the balance sheet date (materials 112/501, goods 132/504, products 123/583), reclassifies inventory shortages to 549 and surpluses to 648. The opening stock is charged to consumption when the new year is opened.
stock.closing_title: Closing stock as of the balance sheet date
stock.no_data: No data yet — post the step with the button below; the system computes the closing stock from stock records.
stock.skipped: The inventory step was skipped (the company does not keep inventory under double-entry bookkeeping).

profit_distribution.title: Profit distribution
profit_distribution.description: Distribution of profit / settlement of loss after approval (431 → 428/429, fund allocations, shareholder shares 364 + withholding tax 342). Booked into the open period.
profit_distribution.already_booked: Profit distribution is already booked for this period.
profit_distribution.date_required: Enter the general meeting decision date.
profit_distribution.shareholder_row_hint: Each Shareholder shares row must represent one shareholder; withholding tax is rounded down separately for each shareholder.

approve.confirm_text_17_7: Once the financial statements are approved, the books can no longer be reopened (§17(7) of the Accounting Act). Corrections are made in the following period (§35).
approve.revoke_text: Revoking the approval is an audited operation — state a reason (min. 10 characters). The period returns to the Closed state.
approve.locked_hint: The statements are approved — the books can no longer be reopened (§17/7).

reopen.title: Reopening period {year}
reopen.text: Reopening a closed period touches closed accounting records and is recorded in the audit trail. If closing entries exist, first undo the Open the new year and Close the books steps.

series.title: Document series
series.hint: Journal document series per year — the prefix, number format and next number are editable, numbers are issued sequentially and gaps after deleted entries are not reused.
series.empty: No document series yet — they are created when the first number is issued.
series.format_hint: The number format is optional — an empty field means the built-in PREFIX-YYYY-CCCC. Placeholders (always in curly braces): PREFIX series prefix · YYYY 4-digit year · YY 2-digit year · C+ counter, the number of Cs sets the width. For example PREFIX and CCCCC in curly braces with prefix 26HP yields 26HP00011.
series.prefix_invalid: The prefix must be 1–10 uppercase letters or digits.
series.format_invalid: The number format must contain a counter — add e.g. CCCC in curly braces, otherwise numbers would repeat.
series.next_number_invalid: The next number must be an integer between 1 and 999999999.

settings.title: Closing & statement settings
settings.statutory_audit: Subject to statutory audit (§20 of the Accounting Act)
settings.statutory_audit_hint: An audited entity always prepares full-scope statements (§3a of Decree 500/2002 Coll.).
settings.manual_doc_series: Automatic document numbers for manual entries (ID series)
settings.manual_doc_series_hint: A manual entry without a document number gets one from the ID series.
settings.fx_reversal_at_open: Reverse receivable/payable revaluation on the first day of the new period
settings.fx_reversal_at_open_hint: Unrealised FX differences on receivables and payables are reversed on the first day of the new year (the subledger keeps the document rate).
settings.small_asset_accrual_hint: Accounting policy (§7 ZoÚ, optional): how small assets up to CZK 80,000 are spread onto 381. None = full cost in the year of acquisition; pro-rata = by acquisition date; flat = fixed % of the price. Pre-filled in the closing 'Accruals' step.

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts (261)
transfer.hint: Two legs of a transfer via 261 — Money in transit: dispatch (Dr 261 / Cr from-account) and receipt (Dr to-account / Cr 261). Both legs share a PP-series document number.
transfer.same_accounts: The source and target accounts must differ.
transfer.fields_required: Fill in both accounts, a positive amount and both dates.
transfer.bank_candidates_warning: A bank transaction for this transfer exists — post it from the statement; a manual entry would duplicate it.

archive.title: Accounting archive
archive.subtitle: Per-company archival of accounting data — ZIP export with a manifest and checksums (§31/§32 of the Accounting Act).
archive.info: The archive contains the company's accounting data in JSON Lines format: periods, chart of accounts, journal, posting rules, assets, depreciation, invoices, bank and codebooks, including a manifest with SHA-256 checksums. PDF documents are not included (covered by the PDF backup).
archive.restore_note: Restoring an archive is a server-admin CLI helper only (api/bin/archive-restore.php, dry-run validation only) — it cannot be done from the application.

errors.version_conflict: The period was modified by another user — data has been reloaded.
errors.closing_entries_exist: Closing entries exist — first undo the Open the new year and Close the books steps.
errors.use_closing_workflow: Use the closing wizard — the status cannot be changed directly.
errors.bank_transfer_candidates: Bank transactions for this transfer exist — see the warning.
errors.cross_currency_manual_only: Confirm cross-currency transfers with a manual entry.
errors.period_overlap: The period overlaps an existing period.
errors.period_gap: The following period does not immediately follow the closed period.
errors.previous_period_open: The previous period must be closed first.
errors.closing_unbalanced_702: The closing entry is not balanced (final balance sheet account 702) — check the journal.
errors.missing_account: A required closing account is missing from the chart of accounts.
errors.period_not_open: The fiscal period is not open.
errors.precheck_errors_exist: Pre-closing checks contain errors — the books cannot be closed.

monthly_check.title: Monthly check
monthly_check.subtitle: Completeness and balance-inventory checks over any date range — any time during the year, without starting the year-end closing.
monthly_check.empty: No result yet — run the check with the button above.
monthly_check.lock_current: Locked until {date} — documents dated on or before this day cannot be posted.
monthly_check.lock_confirm: Really set the lock to {date}? Documents dated on or before this day will no longer be postable.

tax_base_adjustments.title: Tax-base adjustments report
tax_base_adjustments.subtitle: CIT reference data — the difference between tax and book depreciation, disposed assets, and informational balances of accrual accounts and FX differences. The system posts nothing.
tax_base_adjustments.no_disposals: No assets were disposed of in this period.

error.unbalanced_entry: The entry is not balanced (Dr ≠ Cr).
error.period_not_open: The fiscal period is not open.
error.duplicate_account: An account with this code already exists.
error.duplicate_period: A fiscal period for this year already exists.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.

profile_signing.title: Electronic signatures
profile_signing.subtitle: Manage your own signing profiles and certificates.
profile_signing.disabled_text: An admin must first allow users to manage their own signing profiles in electronic signature settings.
profile_signing.form_hint: The profile will be tied to your user account.
profile_signing.credential_hint: The certificate is shared by all enabled profile usages. Prefer picking one from the Certificates section — that is where it is uploaded once for the whole app.
profile_signing.credential_save_first: The certificate can be uploaded after the profile is saved for the first time.
profile_signing.default_profiles_hint: When signed-in user selection is active, the app uses the selected profile for the output type.
profile_signing.default_profile_active: Your own profile will be used for this output.
profile_signing.output_mapping_disabled: Signing for this PDF output is disabled in administration; your own profile will not be used.
profile_signing.output_mapping_not_user: This PDF output is not configured to use the signed-in user source in administration; your own profile will not be used.
profile_signing.output_usage_mismatch: The selected profile does not support {outputUsage}. Profile supports: {profileUsages}.

electronic_signatures.title: Electronic signatures
electronic_signatures.subtitle: Certificates, signing profiles and PDF output mapping.

purchase_invoice.title: Received invoices
purchase_invoice.subtitle: Vendor documents — company expenses.
purchase_invoice.advance_posting_hint: An advance document is not posted as a liability. Its bank or cash payment is posted to account 314 instead.
purchase_invoice.empty_client: No received invoices yet. Upload your first one.

fields.vendor_invoice_number_hint: As written on the original (e.g. FA-2026-001)
fields.varsymbol_hint: Optional — auto-generated as PF2605001 (prefix by tax type) on receipt
fields.tax_date_rc_hint: Under reverse charge the document is assigned to the VAT period by the tax point date (the obligation to declare tax arises regardless of receiving the document). For EU goods acquisitions the tax point is, per § 25 of the Czech VAT Act, the 15th day of the month following delivery, unless the invoice was issued earlier.
fields.vat_claim_hint: Input VAT from this document falls into the {period} period — {basis}. Under § 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act the deduction can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document, so the tax point alone cannot pull the document into its own month if it was issued or received later.

vat_claim_basis.issue_date: driven by the issue date (you cannot hold the document earlier)

fields.vat_claim_received_note: Check that the date received matches the day you actually got the document — after AI extraction it is pre-filled with the processing date. Until you edit the field, it does not affect the deduction period.
fields.currency_add_hint: Add a currency for received invoices (created as inactive for issued)
fields.currency_add_iso_hint: ISO 4217 code (3 letters), e.g. USD, GBP, CHF
fields.currency_add_inactive_note: Created as inactive (purchases only). If you want to issue invoices in it, activate it later in Settings and add a bank account.
fields.currency_add_advanced_hint: To activate (bank account, rate, decimals), go to
fields.currency_inactive_hint: This currency is inactive for issued invoices (no bank account). Only usable for received invoice tracking.
fields.prices_include_vat_hint: Item prices are gross (incl. VAT) — typical for receipts; VAT is calculated top-down so the total matches to the cent.
fields.vendor_is_vat_payer_hint: Verified online from ARES (CZ) / VIES (EU). If the vendor is not a VAT payer, the VAT deduction is disabled automatically and rates set to 0%. Can be overridden.
fields.is_fixed_asset_hint: Invoice covers long-term assets per § 4(4)(c) of CZ VAT Act (vehicle, machinery). Value is reported additionally on DPHDP3 row 47 as supplementary data.
fields.is_fixed_asset_derived_hint: Derived from items — ticked as soon as at least one item has the expense kind “Fixed asset”. An asset invoice per § 4(4)(c) is additionally reported on DPHDP3 row 47.

small_asset.badge_tooltip: Document contains a small asset — at least one item has the expense kind “Small asset”.

items.title: Items
items.gross_edit_hint: You can overwrite with the gross (incl. VAT) amount — the net unit price is back-calculated.
items.expense_kind_hint: Drives the expense account: Service → 518, Material (incl. fuel) → 501, Small asset → 501 + asset record, Fixed asset → 042 and depreciation. Unspecified behaves as before (518).
items.accrual_hint: Cost belongs to a from–to period (insurance, parking, subscription). The part beyond year-end is deferred to 381 (prepaid expenses) at closing.
items.empty: No items — add at least one to calculate totals.

totals.rounding_hint: Difference between items sum and rounded amount on the invoice (typically +/− 0.5 CZK).

payment_currency.toggle: Paying in different currency than invoice
payment_currency.hint: Fill in if paying USD invoice from CZK/EUR account. Diff is used for FX gain/loss tracking.

actions.mark_booked_hint: Internal flag — you mark that the invoice is already booked in your accounting system (Pohoda, Money, external accountant). VAT/KH/SH reports do NOT respect this status (they include 'received' too).

confirm.force_delete_warning: ⚠️ Warning! Really delete a NON-DRAFT invoice? This invoice is no longer a draft — it has 'received' or 'booked' status. Deletion is irreversible and may affect VAT reports.
confirm.force_delete_confirm: Second confirmation: delete invoice with archived PDF? Action is permanent.
confirm.delete_blocked: Only drafts can be deleted. For already received use Cancel.
confirm.cancel: Really cancel this invoice? This cannot be undone.

transition.invalid: Cannot transition to requested state from current.

vat_recap.title: VAT recap and accounting allocations
vat_recap.hint: Values are derived from the line items. If the supplier document states a different base or VAT (rounding), override them here — they will be stored exactly as on the document (§ 73 VAT Act).
vat_recap.overridden_note: Recapitulation manually adjusted to the document — VAT is not recomputed.

vat_allocation.hint: Allocations do not change the supplier's VAT recap. They only define the VAT deduction and debit account for each part. The first business row is calculated as the remainder.
vat_allocation.invalid: Accounting allocations must have a valid description, account and non-negative amounts and must fully cover the VAT recap.

pdf.title: Vendor original PDF
pdf.dropzone_hint: Drag a PDF or photo of the invoice here (or click to pick)
pdf.dropzone_hint_structured: Drag a PDF, photo or ISDOC/ISDOCX invoice here (or click to pick)
pdf.delete_confirm: Really delete the archived PDF? The invoice stays — only the attachment will be removed. This cannot be undone.
pdf.pending_upload: {name} will be uploaded after saving the invoice
pdf.pending_badge: Will be uploaded after saving the invoice
pdf.no_pdf: No archived PDF for this invoice.
pdf.max_size_hint_structured: PDF, image, ISDOC or ISDOCX, max 20 MiB
pdf.invalid_pdf: File must be a PDF or image (JPG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC).
pdf.invalid_document: File must be a PDF, image, ISDOC or ISDOCX.
pdf.duplicate: The same PDF is already archived under another invoice.

source.badge_title: Machine-readable source document — click to download

warning.credit_note_positive_total: Credit note has a positive total — it should have negative amounts. A negative sign on one side is enough (e.g. −1 pc × 1000, or 1 pc × −1000); if both quantity and price are negative, VAT/control-statement reports will add the amount instead of subtracting it. Please check the signs.
warning.exchange_rate_cnb_deviation: The rate on the document ({used}) differs from the daily CNB rate ({cnb}) for the relevant day by {diff} %. Please check the rate. This is the accounting conversion — the CZK VAT amount on the document (§73/6) is unaffected.
warning.vendor_non_payer_deduction: The vendor is not a VAT payer, yet a VAT deduction is claimed. VAT cannot be deducted from a non-payer — please check the deduction setting.
warning.vendor_unreliable_payer: According to the VAT payer registry (CRPDPH), the vendor is listed as an unreliable VAT payer — paying them carries liability risk for unpaid VAT (§109 VAT Act). Consider special-mode payment (§109a) or verifying with the vendor.
warning.advance_has_tax_document: The linked advance already has a tax document for payment (DDKP) — its VAT was claimed separately. On this final invoice claim the deduction only from the VAT TOP-UP (the difference against the DDKP), otherwise the deduction would be taken twice.
warning.receipt_looks_like_prepayment: This document is classified as a receipt, but its content looks like a tax document for a received payment (advance). A receipt books the cost (518) immediately — when the final invoice later arrives, the cost is double-counted. Consider the type "Tax document for payment" (DDKP → VAT deduction only, 343/314) or "Advance".
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded: The relevant date (tax point) or the currency changed, but the exchange rate stayed as it was ({rate} as of {date}) — {reason} Please check the rate on the document.
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded_source_locked: the rate on the document does not come from an automatic conversion (a person entered it, it came from an import, or its origin is unknown), so automation does not overwrite it.
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded_cnb_unavailab: the CNB rate for the new date could not be fetched.
warning.public_authority_fee_out_of_scope: This document looks like a public-authority fee (court fee, administrative fee, duty stamp). A public authority acting in that capacity is not a taxable person (Section 5(4) of the Czech VAT Act), so the supply is outside the scope of VAT — including fees charged by a foreign court or office: no self-assessment under Section 9(1), and the document enters neither the VAT return nor the control statement. That is why no VAT classification was assigned. If this really is an ordinary purchased service, pick the classification manually.
warning.missing_vat_classification: This document carries VAT (or is under reverse charge) but has no VAT classification, so it reaches neither the VAT return nor the control statement. Typically a rate the Czech codebook does not know (e.g. German 19%) or a vendor with an undetermined country. Check the line rates and pick a classification manually.

classification.title: Classification
classification.project_hint: Assigns the cost to an event — revenue, costs and margin are shown on the project detail.
classification.vat_classification_hint: If unset, the code is derived from the VAT rate and the vendor country: domestic 21% → 40, 12% → 41, domestic reverse charge → 5, EU service → 24e (line 5), non-EU service → 24 (line 12). Zero-rated domestic supplies (exempt, non-payer) and public-authority fees (court, administrative) get no code — they belong to neither the VAT return nor the control statement.
classification.vat_deduction_hint: “None” = invoice is excluded from the VAT ledger and DPHDP3/KH (accounting cost only). “Proportional” = partial deduction §75 — enter the % the deduction is reduced to.
classification.tax_deductible_hint: Affects income tax (DPFO/DPPO) only, not VAT. Turn off for non-deductible costs (entertainment…).

purchase_invoice.vat_deduction_reduced_hint: An input used for both taxable and exempt-without-entitlement supplies (§51) — e.g. rent, utilities, accounting fees at a company with exempt income. The deduction is reduced by a company-wide, per-year coefficient (set by an admin), not a per-invoice percentage. The invoice can't be posted until a coefficient is set.
purchase_invoice.vat_deduction_percent_hint: Percentage the VAT deduction is reduced to (e.g. car 70 % for business). The rest is a non-deductible part.
purchase_invoice.force_edit_hint: Admin only — edit received/booked/paid invoice. For paid invoices, beware: changing the amount may break matching with the bank transaction. Totals will be recomputed.

recurring.placeholders_intro: Replaced on every invoice generation based on the tax date (issue date for proformas). They also work in the notes above/below items carried over from the template. Unrecognized tokens are left untouched. Examples below for tax date May 15, 2026:

placeholders_rows.d: month → 5, 05 · shift by months incl. year rollover: {'{MM+8}'} → 01
month name per document language → May · {'{MMMM+1}'} → June
full date → May 15, 2026 · ±D/M/Y arithmetic: {'{DATE+1Y-1D}'} → May 14, 2027 · month overflow is clamped (Jan 31 {'{DATE+1M}'} → Feb 28)
start/end of month → May 1, 2026, May 31, 2026 · shift by months: {'{EOM+1}'} → Jun 30, 2026, {'{EOM-1}'} → Apr 30, 2026

recurring.placeholders_example: Example: "Renewal of domain example.cz for period {'{DATE}'} - {'{DATE+1Y-1D}'}" → "Renewal of domain example.cz for period May 15, 2026 - May 14, 2027"

license.model_subtitle: A free foundation forever, with a paid accounting extension on top.
license.model_intro: Invoicing, documents, contacts, bank and cash are free in MyÚčto and will stay free. A license unlocks the accounting extension built on top of them.
model_points: The free foundation stays available after the trial ends.
A commercial license unlocks double-entry accounting, accounting tools and closing, stock and e-commerce, asset records, EPO integration and advanced VAT corrections.
Pricing is per active user and month; read-only and deactivated accounts do not count.
The license is bound to a unique installation identifier; one key runs on one installation.
The app verifies the license online roughly once a day; a brief loss of internet does not limit operation.
Only technical data is transmitted (identifier, key, version, counts). No accounting or personal data.
license.trial_body: For the first 60 days after first launch you have full access for free, without registration or payment. Afterwards the paid accounting modules are hidden and their pages and APIs are unavailable until you activate a license. The free foundation remains fully usable.
license.tiers_body: Single company (1 agenda), Accounting office (up to 10 agendas) and Unlimited (no company limit). An annual subscription costs 10 monthly payments.
license.readonly_body: After the license expires (and a 14-day grace period), invoicing and the entire free foundation remain fully operational. Double-entry accounting, Tools and closing, stock and e-commerce, asset records, EPO integration, income tax and advanced VAT corrections are unavailable. Their data remains unchanged in the database and becomes available again after activation.

terms_articles.title: 1. Subscription, plans and pricing
terms_articles.body: Three plans by number of company agendas (1 company / up to 10 / unlimited). Pricing is per active user and month, excluding VAT; VAT is added. Monthly or annual period (annual = 10 monthly payments).

terms_articles.title: 2. Order and conclusion of contract
terms_articles.body: You choose the plan, number of users, period and billing details. After a summary and the first payment the contract is concluded and you receive a confirmation and license key by e-mail.

terms_articles.title: 3. Payment terms and recurring payments
terms_articles.body: Card payments via the GoPay gateway; card details are not available to the provider. Payment recurs with your consent, at a fixed amount, monthly or annually. You can cancel any time, effective at the end of the paid period.

terms_articles.title: 4. Delivery and activation of the license
terms_articles.body: The key is sent immediately after payment (usually within minutes). Activation happens directly in the app. Scope upgrades take effect immediately.

terms_articles.title: 5. Term, termination and refunds
terms_articles.body: The license lasts the paid period and extends with further payments. Cancellation is possible any time; the license runs until the end of the period with no pro-rata refund. The first 60 days are free.

terms_articles.title: 6. Trial period and unlicensed scope
terms_articles.body: 60 days free from first launch. After the subscription expires and a 14-day grace period, the paid accounting modules become unavailable; the free foundation remains fully operational and paid-module data is not deleted.

terms_articles.title: 7. Support and liability
terms_articles.body: Complaints are handled by e-mail, resolved within 30 days. The software does not replace the user's professional judgment. Consumers have the right to out-of-court dispute resolution via the Czech Trade Inspection.
