updates.how_docker_desc: Clicking 'Update' writes a flag file `storage/upgrade-requested.json`. A host-side watcher (`cmd/docker-update-watcher.(sh/ps1)` as systemd unit / Scheduled Task) picks it up and runs `cmd/docker-update.(sh/ps1)` — pulling the new image, restarting the stack, running migrations. The result and log appear on this page.
updates.how_docker_setup: If the watcher is not yet installed, follow § 19.4 of the manual (systemd unit on Linux, Scheduled Task on Windows). Without the watcher, run on the host manually after clicking 'Update':
updates.how_native_desc: Clicking "Update" downloads the production bundle from the GitHub release (`myucto-X.Y.Z.tar.gz`), verifies its SHA-256, deploys it over the installation and runs migrations — no Composer or Node needed on the host, the bundle ships vendor, web/dist and the manual prebuilt. Configuration (`cfg*.php`) and data (`storage/`, `private/`, `log/`) are never overwritten and replaced files are backed up to `storage/updates/<version>/backup/`.
updates.trigger_native_confirm: Update to {version}? The app will download the production bundle from the GitHub release, deploy it over this installation and run migrations. Configuration and data are left untouched and overwritten files are backed up. Having a fresh database backup is recommended.
updates.in_progress_native_desc: A background worker is downloading the bundle, deploying files and running migrations. Keep the installation running — progress refreshes automatically.

invoice.delete_issued_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting ISSUED credit note {varsymbol}

A credit note is a valid accounting record — has a generated number and may be in your accountant's books.

What happens:
• Credit note is permanently removed from the database
• Cached PDF is deleted from disk
• Any linked cancellation document is deleted TOO
• Number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• The original invoice is NOT affected — it stays in its current status (typically cancelled)
• Action is audited (invoice.force_deleted)

Continue?
invoice.delete_sent_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting SENT credit note {varsymbol}

This credit note was already emailed to the client. Deleting will cause a mismatch between your records and what the client has.

What happens:
• Credit note is permanently removed from the database (incl. archived sent PDF)
• Any linked cancellation document is deleted TOO
• Number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• The original invoice stays unchanged
• Action is audited

Really continue?
invoice.delete_cancelled_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting CANCELLED credit note {varsymbol}

Deletes both the credit note AND the linked cancellation document — both go in cascade.

What happens:
• Both credit note {varsymbol} AND its cancellation document are removed
• Their numbers become available
• The original invoice stays unchanged
• Action is audited

This is irreversible. Continue?
invoice.delete_issued_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting ISSUED invoice {varsymbol}

This is a valid accounting record — has a generated invoice number, supplier and client snapshots, and may already be in your accountant's books.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database
• Cached PDF is deleted from disk
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• If matched to a bank transaction, the transaction stays but loses its pair
• Invoice number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• Action is audited (invoice.force_deleted)

Recommended: issue a CANCELLATION or CREDIT NOTE instead of deleting. Continue?
invoice.delete_sent_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting SENT invoice {varsymbol}

This invoice was already emailed to the client. They have it in their inbox / may have it in their accounting. Deleting will cause a mismatch between your records and what the client has.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database (incl. archived sent PDF)
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• Invoice number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• Action is audited

Recommended: issue a CANCELLATION or CREDIT NOTE and explain to the client. Really continue?
invoice.delete_paid_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting PAID invoice {varsymbol}

This invoice is issued, sent, paid by the client, and the money is in your bank account. You're deleting an accounting record that corresponds to a real payment.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database
• If matched to a bank transaction, the transaction stays but loses its pair (find it again in unmatched)
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• Revenue / KPIs on dashboard and client/project pages are recomputed
• Action is audited

Recommended: if accidentally marked paid, use Unpay (admin). If returning money, issue a CREDIT NOTE. Really delete?
invoice.delete_cancelled_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting CANCELLED invoice {varsymbol}

Deletes both the original invoice AND the linked cancellation document — both go in cascade.

What happens:
• Both invoice {varsymbol} AND its cancellation document are removed
• Their numbers become available
• If paid, bank transaction loses its pair
• Action is audited

This is irreversible. Continue?

payments.recorded_paid: Payment recorded — the document is fully paid.
payments.locked_bank: Payment from bank matching — remove it via “Unmatch” in the statement detail.
payments.bank_transactions_hint: The transaction is directly matched to the invoice but is not counted separately in the payment ledger. The displayed details come from the original bank record.
payments.imported_without_details: The document is recorded as paid on {date}, but payment details are unavailable.

invoice.price_list_added: The price list item was inserted into the document.
invoice.price_list_requires_context: Select a customer and document currency before inserting a price list item.

asset_sale.hint: Shows an asset card picker on every line. The selected card decides the revenue account and closes itself once the invoice is issued — a minor asset becomes sold, a fixed asset is disposed of including its residual value.
asset_sale.not_closed: The invoice was issued, but the card “{name}” could not be closed:

smtp_log.title: SMTP analysis
smtp_log.hint: What the mail server did with this sent invoice — on the send day and the next day, for this invoice's recipients.
smtp_log.not_sent: This invoice has not been e-mailed yet.
smtp_log.no_events: Nothing found in the server log for these recipients on that day.

classification.title: Classification
classification.vat_classification_hint: If unset, the code is derived from the VAT rate (21% → 1, 12% → 2, reverse charge → 20/22/25s by customer). Zero-rated (exempt) supplies get no code — pick one manually.
classification.revenue_category_hint: Category for revenue breakdown in CRM and stats. Managed in Codebooks.

advance_link.none: Not linked to any advance invoice.
advance_link.none_final: Not linked to any tax document.
advance_link.modal_title: Select an advance invoice to link
advance_link.modal_title_final: Select a tax document to link
advance_link.no_candidates: No unlinked advance invoices for this customer.
advance_link.no_candidates_final: No unlinked tax documents for this customer.

signing.title: Electronic signature
signing.hint: This setting applies only to this document and overrides the system output mapping. Saving the invoice setting invalidates the cached PDF.

attachments.title: Email attachments
attachments.hint: These files are bundled with the invoice PDF when sending to the client (not with reminders). Max 10 MiB per file, 20 MiB total.
attachments.pending_hint: Attached to the PDF when sent to the client. Uploaded after the invoice is created. Max 10 MiB/file, 20 MiB total.
attachments.post_save_failed: Invoice created, but attachments could not be uploaded — please add them in the invoice detail.

invoice.bulk_oss_hint: {n} documents selected. The preview shows what changes and what is skipped — the change cannot run without it.
invoice.bulk_oss_scope_needs_review: Only rows flagged for manual review
invoice.bulk_oss_scope_missing_rate_type: Only OSS rows without a rate type
invoice.bulk_oss_clear_review_hint: Clears the “place of supply needs manual review” flag. Confirming the place of supply is a human decision; the system never clears it on its own.
invoice.bulk_oss_partial: OSS set on {ok} documents, {err} skipped — see the preview for reasons.
invoice.edit_issued_body: You are editing invoice {varsymbol} in status {status}. Changes will overwrite snapshots and may desynchronize the document with the client's records. The action is audited. For the client, we recommend issuing a credit note instead.
invoice.edit_issued_confirm:
⚠ WARNING — editing an ISSUED invoice

Invoice {varsymbol} has already been issued{sent}.

Editing will:
• change the content of a document the client may already have in their books
• overwrite JSON snapshots (immutability is broken)
• keep the original varsymbol (no new one is generated)
• be audited in ActivityLog

Recommended: issue a credit note instead. Continue to the editor anyway?
invoice.credit_note_warning: ⚠ Manual credit note — if it relates to a specific invoice, issue it via Cancel / credit note in that invoice's detail.
invoice.type_change_renumber: ⚠ Changing the type renumbers the document — the current number {varsymbol} is released back to its series and a new number from the target type's series is assigned.
invoice.payment_calendar_hint: A calendar is a tax document only with a schedule of payments for a predetermined period (§ 31 and § 31a of the Czech VAT Act). Individual documents are then not issued for each instalment.
invoice.payment_schedule_required: Without a payment schedule the calendar cannot be issued — it would not be a tax document.
invoice.payment_schedule_mismatch: The schedule total ({total}) does not match the document total ({invoice}). Issuing will be rejected.
invoice.simplified_document_hint: Up to CZK 10,000 including VAT; need not state the customer, the tax base or the tax amount (§ 30a).
invoice.simplified_blocked_limit: Above the {limit} limit — the document totals {total} including VAT. A simplified document cannot be issued (§ 30(1) VAT Act).
invoice.simplified_blocked_reverse_charge: A simplified document cannot be issued under the reverse charge regime (§ 30(2)) — the customer needs their VAT ID on the document, otherwise the supply drops out of the control statement.
invoice.simplified_blocked_eu: A simplified document cannot be issued for goods supplied to another member state (§ 30(2)) — without identifying the customer the supply cannot be reported in the EC sales list.
invoice.reverse_charge_io_hint: You invoice without VAT — the amounts shown are the tax base. The customer self-assesses VAT at their country's rate; no Czech VAT rate appears on the document. The supply is included in the EC Sales List.
invoice.prices_include_vat_hint: Item prices are gross (incl. VAT); VAT is calculated top-down so the total matches to the cent.
invoice.income_tax_exempt_hint: Not included in the income-tax base. VAT, control statement and turnover are unaffected.
invoice.income_tax_exempt_reason_placeholder: Reason for exemption (optional) — e.g. sale of vehicle § 4(1)(c), pass-through reinvoicing
invoice.auto_send_reminders_hint: When off, the cron will not send automatic reminders for this invoice (even if the supplier and client have them enabled). Manual send always works.

items_table.gross_edit_hint: You can overwrite with the gross (incl. VAT) amount — the net unit price is back-calculated.

czk_recap.title: CZK conversion
czk_recap.fallback_note: rate from an earlier available day
czk_recap.warning_fallback: CNB had no rate for the issue date — used rate {rate} CZK/{currency} from {date}.
czk_recap.warning_last_known: CNB unavailable — used last known rate {rate} CZK/{currency} from {date}.

warning.exchange_rate_cnb_deviation: The rate on the document ({used}) differs from the daily CNB rate ({cnb}) for the tax date by {diff} %. Please check the rate.
warning.credit_note_positive_total: The credit note has a positive total — in the VAT return and control statement the supply will be ADDED instead of deducted, while the journal reverses it. Flip the sign: negative quantity or negative price (one is enough).
warning.oss_document_contradiction: The document contradicts itself: some lines are in the OSS scheme and some stayed taxed domestically, so one invoice sits in two different returns. We saved it — a single invoice may legitimately do both — but the affected lines are flagged for manual review. Check the rates: if the domestic lines belong to OSS too, they must carry the rate of the country of consumption.
warning.oss_derived_notes: The document arrived through the API without OSS data, so we derived the scheme ourselves. Per-line details are in the API response (`_warning_meta.oss_derived_notes`); lines whose place of supply could not be determined are flagged for manual review.

invoice.exchange_rate_hint: After the initial fetch from CNB the rate stays fixed. You can override it manually — the stored value is used in the PDF and exports.
invoice.exchange_rate_fixed_missing: The company uses a fixed rate mode (§24/7), but no fixed rate is set for {currency} in this period — the document was saved with the daily CNB rate instead. Add the fixed rate in Accounting settings.
invoice.bank_not_set: Bank account for {currency} is not configured in settings
invoice.wr_saved_and_synced: Work report saved and invoice item synced
invoice.wr_sync_note: On save, the work report is stored and its total is written as one invoice item (qty=1, price=total). If an item with the same description exists, it's updated.
invoice.wr_material_price_incl: Enter material prices including VAT (document is in VAT-inclusive mode).
invoice.wr_not_in_items_confirm:
Work report "{description}" has {hours}h for {amount} {ccy}, but is not listed as an invoice item.

Continue without transferring the work report to the invoice?
invoice.wr_material_not_in_items_confirm:
Material report “{description}” for {amount} {ccy} is not entered as an invoice item.

Continue without transferring the material to the invoice?
invoice.wr_hint: The work report prints on a second page of the invoice PDF. If filled, set the invoice item manually (e.g. "Extra work {title} — total {hours}h × {rate} {currency}").
invoice.proforma_no_tax_point: Proforma has no tax point. The tax document is issued after payment.
invoice.bulk_clone_confirm:
Clone {n} invoices to next month?

Item descriptions will shift (e.g. "3/2026" → "4/2026"). Drafts are created — none will be sent or issued automatically.
invoice.bulk_send_confirm:
Send {n} invoices to clients?

E-mail goes to the client's main address + project billing emails. If the client has no email, the invoice will be skipped.

modals.partial_payment_remaining: {remaining} remaining. Covering the full amount marks the document as paid automatically.
modals.cancel_credit_desc: For the client — creates a draft with negative values, you'll review the editor and issue.
modals.cancel_internal_desc: For incorrectly issued invoices, the client doesn't receive any document.
modals.cancel_internal_desc_cn: For incorrectly issued credit notes, the client doesn't receive any document.
modals.cancel_delete_desc: Permanently removes the accounting record from the database, including cached PDF, archive of sent versions, and user attachments. Any linked cancellation/credit-note will be deleted TOGETHER. After confirmation you will see a detailed warning based on the current status (issued / sent / paid / cancelled). Recommended only as a last resort.
modals.cancel_delete_desc_cn: Permanently removes the credit note from the database, including cached PDF, archive of sent versions, and user attachments. Any linked cancellation document will be deleted TOGETHER. The original invoice is NOT affected — it stays in its current status. If it frees the last number in the credit-note sequence, that number is released. Recommended only as a last resort.
modals.send_default_hint: Pre-filled from client contacts (Documents purpose), project billing emails and the main email; duplicates merged. Edit the list freely.
modals.send_note_placeholder: Added to the email body above the invoice details. Each new line = new paragraph.
modals.send_note_hint: The note is added only to the email, NOT to the invoice PDF.
modals.reminder_body: Client will receive an email reminder with the invoice PDF. Status will change to "Reminded" and the reminder count will be incremented.

invoice.bulk_pdf_hint: Creates one PDF file from {n} selected documents in list order. The output contains invoices only, without attachments or work reports.
invoice.bulk_pdf_sign_hint: Uses the active signing profile configured for invoice PDFs. The export reports an error if no usable profile is available.
invoice.bulk_pdf_limit: You can export up to 100 invoices at once.

oss.rate_type_missing_hint: Without a rate type the line will not reach the OSS return. Set it according to the rate applicable in the Member State of consumption.
oss.clause_hint: VAT is declared and paid in the Member State of consumption under the OSS scheme; the document carries the clause in the PDF and in the public preview.
oss.clause_countries_unknown: Member State of consumption not stated
oss.needs_review_hint: The system could not determine the place of supply for this line — check the country of consumption and the rate type. Use the cross to clear the flag.

invoice.rebuild_snapshots_confirm: Overwrite supplier, customer and bank details on this document with their current values? Amounts, status and document number stay unchanged. The generated PDF is invalidated and the new one may differ from the one the customer received.
invoice.bulk_oss_failure_pdf_stale: PDF cache could not be invalidated for {n} documents
invoice.bulk_oss_failure_retry_hint: The unprocessed documents are unchanged and stay selected — once the cause is fixed, run the action again over them only.
invoice.bulk_oss_pdf_stale_hint: The data is saved, but the stored PDF is stale. Regenerate it before sending the document.

payment_method.label: Payment method
payment_method.hint: For card or cash payments the PDF and email omit the QR code and bank account.
payment_method.purchase_hint: No payment order is created for direct debit — the vendor collects the amount themselves.
payment_method.include_non_transfer: Also show invoices not paid by bank transfer
payment_method.include_non_transfer_hint: Direct debit, card, cash on delivery and offset are never added to a payment order. Turn this on to fix an incorrectly marked invoice.
payment_method.non_transfer_tooltip: This invoice is not paid by bank transfer and cannot be added to a payment order. Change the payment method in the invoice editor.
payment_method.vendor_default_hint: Prefills new invoices from this vendor. A manual choice on the invoice always wins.
payment_method.paid_by_card: Paid online by card — please do not pay again.

supplier.title: Suppliers
supplier.delete_confirm: Delete supplier? Only possible if no clients or invoices.
supplier.create_hint: After creation, default CZK + EUR currencies are auto-seeded. Fill in bank account info in Settings after switching to the new supplier.
supplier.ares_invalid_ic: Company ID must be exactly 8 digits.
supplier.ares_loaded_email_hint: ARES does not return e-mail — please fill it in manually below.
supplier.bank_lookup_no_dic: Fill in the VAT ID (DIČ) first.
supplier.bank_lookup_none: The VAT payer register returned no published account.
supplier.bank_lookup_one: Account loaded from the VAT payer register.
supplier.bank_lookup_many: The register returned {n} accounts — the first was filled in; you can pick another.
supplier.bank_lookup_unreliable: ⚠ Warning: this entity is listed as an UNRELIABLE VAT PAYER.
supplier.bank_lookup_failed: Loading the account from the VAT register failed.

client.title: Clients
client.branding_profile_hint: Automatically selected on new invoices for this client.

bank_accounts.title: Counterparty bank accounts
bank_accounts.hint: Accounts can be entered manually, loaded from the VAT register, or learned from a confirmed bank transaction match.
bank_accounts.empty: No bank account is recorded for this counterparty yet.
bank_accounts.add_failed: The bank account could not be added.
bank_accounts.delete_failed: The bank account could not be removed.
bank_accounts.synced: Accounts loaded from the VAT register: {count}.
bank_accounts.sync_empty: The VAT register returned no published bank account.
bank_accounts.sync_failed: Loading accounts from the VAT register failed.

client.dual_role_tooltip: Customer and vendor — we both invoice and purchase
client.roles_hint: Client role — an entity can be both a customer (we invoice them) and a vendor (we buy from them).
client.is_fuel_station_hint: for recognizing refuelling and charging in the trip log
client.roles_required: Pick at least one role (customer or vendor).
client.default_expense_category_hint: Pre-filled on new received invoices from this vendor. On save it is also applied to all their existing invoices that have no category set.
client.default_expense_category_backfilled: Default category applied to {count} received invoices without a category.
client.default_revenue_category_hint: Pre-filled on new issued invoices for this customer. On save it is also applied to all their existing invoices that have no category set. The project category takes precedence.
client.default_revenue_category_backfilled: Default revenue category applied to {count} issued invoices without a category.
client.tax_number_hint: National tax number (without country prefix) — printed on invoices next to the VAT ID.
client.tax_number_hint_sk: Slovak tax ID (DIČ) without the SK prefix — assigned to non-VAT payers too.

warning.ic_checksum_invalid: The Reg. No. (IČO) fails the mod-11 checksum — please check for a typo. This does not block saving (the entity may legitimately have an unusual Reg. No.).
warning.dic_format_invalid: The VAT ID (DIČ) has an invalid format (domestic: CZ + 8-10 digits, foreign: country code + alphanumeric code). Please check the entered value.
warning.dic_ic_mismatch: The VAT ID (DIČ) does not match the entered Reg. No. (for domestic legal entities, the VAT ID should carry the same 8 digits as the Reg. No.). Please check both values.

client.duplicate_candidate_warning: A card with the same Reg. No./VAT ID may already exist: {name}. This does not block saving — please check it is not a duplicate.

duplicates.banner_hint: Cards with a matching Reg. No. or VAT ID after normalization (no spaces, no leading zero) — the same vendor's documents may be split between them.

email_contacts.title: Email contacts by purpose
email_contacts.hint: Optional — who receives documents, reminders and approvals. Without contacts everything goes to the main email (+ project billing emails).
email_contacts.main_excluded_note: Note: once a purpose has an assigned contact, the main email is no longer added automatically for that message type. To keep it, add it as a contact ("Use main email").

client.payment_due_month_hint: Calendar month — Feb 1 → Mar 1, Jan 31 → Feb 28 (not a fixed 30 days).
client.hourly_rate_hint: Used as fallback in the invoice editor when no project is selected. 0 = not used.
client.auto_send_reminders_hint: When off, the cron will not send automatic reminders for this client. Manual send (single + bulk) always works.
client.oss_section_hint: OSS (One Stop Shop) — default settings for this customer's documents.
client.oss_mode_hint: Whether a line belongs to OSS is decided by the VAT rate, the customer's country and the member-state rate codebook. Here you can only rule OSS out — typically for a customer you know is a taxable person who simply hasn't supplied a VAT ID yet.
client.oss_default_supply_type_hint: Used when the supply type cannot be derived from the line's unit of measure. Without it the system falls back to “service” and flags the line for review.
client.related_party: Related party (§ 36a VAT Act, § 23(7) Income Tax Act)
client.related_party_hint: Prices agreed with a related party must match arm's-length prices. The system then lists such transactions in the monthly check and, where a comparison exists, computes the deviation from prices charged to unrelated parties.
client.related_party_note_placeholder: Evidence of the relationship — ownership share, director's name, nature of the link
client.numbering_hint: Filling these gives this client a separate invoice series with its own counter. Leave empty to inherit the supplier-wide format.
client.numbering_placeholders_hint: Placeholders (always wrap in curly braces): YYYY 4-digit year · YY 2-digit year · MM month · C+ sequence number; count of C controls padding (CCCC = 4 chars). Year and month accept an offset: YY+30 · MM-1 · YYYY+1. The offset only changes the printed number, not when the series resets.
client.delete_warning:
Delete client "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

Only works if the client has no invoices or projects — otherwise use Archive.
client.empty_hint: A client is the counterparty on an invoice — you cannot issue a document without one. Details can be pulled from the business register by company ID.
client.vat_payer_not_registered: Entity is not listed in the VAT payer register.
client.vat_payer_unavailable: The VAT payer register is temporarily unavailable.
client.vat_payer_source: Source: VAT payer register (MFČR), loaded on demand.
client.vat_payer_vies_not_registered: The VAT ID is not listed as valid in VIES — the entity is not VAT-registered.
client.vat_payer_vies_unavailable: The VIES system is temporarily unavailable.
client.vat_payer_vies_source: Source: VIES (European Commission), loaded on demand.
client.dic_invalid: {dic} is invalid or does not exist
client.duplicate_ic: A client with this Reg. No. already exists:
client.duplicate_dic: A client with this VAT ID already exists:

project.title: Projects
project.info_create_in_client: New projects are created in the client's page — they are always tied to a specific client.

profit.title: Project economics
profit.unposted: This project has {n} unposted documents — they are not included yet.
profit.empty: No documents linked to this project yet.

project.name: Name
project.empty_hint: A project groups the invoices, costs and revenue of one job so you can see what is left on it.
project.payment_due_month_hint: Calendar month — Feb 1 → Mar 1, Jan 31 → Feb 28 (not a fixed 30 days).
project.billing_emails_mode_hint: How project billing emails combine with the client's contacts / main email. "Default" matches the previous behavior.
project.billing_email_no_usage_hint: nothing selected = used for all message types
project.delete_warning:
Delete project "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

Only works if the project has no invoices — otherwise use Archive.
project.requires_approval_hint: Invoice cannot be issued until the customer approves the work report via email. Once approved, the invoice is issued and sent automatically.
project.default_revenue_category_hint: Pre-filled on new issued invoices for this project and takes PRECEDENCE over the customer category. On save it is also applied to all project invoices that have no category set.
project.default_revenue_category_backfilled: Default revenue category applied to {count} project invoices without a category.

bank.title: Bank statements
bank.subtitle: Import GPC/ABO statements + auto-matching to invoices by VS.
bank.upload_hint: GPC/ABO statements are imported directly; PDF (Creditas, ČSOB, KB, Raiffeisenbank) is automatically parsed into transactions.
bank.no_data: No statements. Upload the first GPC file using the button above.
bank.no_data_filtered: No statements match the selected filter.
bank.month_filter: Filter by month (within the selected year)
bank.own_account_filter: Filter by the company's own account
bank.pdf_upload_hint: Attach a PDF version of the bank statement
bank.pdf_delete_confirm: Really delete the attached PDF? The GPC statement and transactions remain.
bank.statement_delete_hint: Delete this e-mail-notice statement and its transactions. Allowed only when it has no matched items (the official GPC statement took the matches over).
bank.statement_delete_confirm: Really delete this e-mail-notice statement including its transactions?
bank.delete_confirm: Really delete statement {name}? Its transactions and invoice matches will be removed; invoice paid status will remain (clear it manually if needed).
bank.upload_batch_attached: {n} PDF attached to an existing statement.
bank.pdf_attached_to_existing: The statement was already imported from GPC — the PDF was attached to it.

warning.transactions_skipped_as_duplicate: The statement had {parsed} transactions, {inserted} were imported. {skipped} matched transactions already on record (overlapping statement) and were not imported — please verify these are genuine duplicates.
warning.transactions_skipped_as_duplicate_batch: {count} transactions from the uploaded statements were skipped as duplicates of already recorded ones — please verify these are genuine duplicates.

bank.choose_account_hint: The file “{file}” matches an account number used in multiple currencies or banks. The statement does not identify it unambiguously — choose the target account.
bank.scan_done: Scan complete: found {scanned}, imported {imported}, duplicates {duplicate}, errors {errors}
bank.create_purchase_hint: Pick an existing vendor (or create one). A received-invoice draft with the gross amount is created; add VAT and PDF in the editor.

document_request.title: Request a document from the client
document_request.hint: The client will see the request in the portal and can upload the document directly.

bank.unmatch_confirm: Unmatch this transaction from the invoice? If the invoice was marked paid by this match, it will be reverted to "Issued".
bank.rematch_confirm: Re-run automatic matching on all unmatched transactions of this statement? Useful when you've added purchase or sales invoices after the statement was imported.
bank.rematch_done: Re-matched: {matched} newly matched, {partial} partial, {remaining} still unmatched.
bank.manual_match_hint_html: Enter the numeric invoice ID from the URL (e.g. /invoices/6).

match_signal.subset_sum: Amount equals sum of {n} client invoices
match_signal.invoice_no_in_message: Invoice number found in payment message
match_signal.known_account: Known counterparty account from earlier payments
match_signal.vs_typo: VS differs by one character — possible typo
match_signal.due_proximity: Payment date is near the due date

match_flag.overpayment: Overpays the invoice by {amount} — confirm manually
match_flag.fee_gap: Short by {amount} — looks like a deducted fee (568 posting will be suggested)
match_flag.vs_typo: VS typos are never matched automatically

bank.email_notice_hint: Monthly summary of payments from bank e-mail notices (not an uploaded statement).
bank.pdf_source_hint: Statement parsed from a PDF (bank without GPC/ABO export), not an uploaded GPC file.
bank.no_candidates: No invoice matches the amount within ±14 days. Match manually by VS.
bank.candidates_fallback_hint: Nothing matched within ±14 days — these are wider suggestions (±90 days), including matches without currency conversion. Verify manually before matching.
bank.candidate_currency_mismatch_hint: The amount matches numerically, but the invoice currency doesn't match the payment currency — this isn't a real exchange-rate conversion. Verify before matching.
bank.split_title: Combined payment (several invoices in one payment)
bank.split_hint: Combinations of one client's invoices whose sum matches this payment (window ±{days} days).
bank.split_hint_all: Combinations of one client’s invoices adding up to this payment (no date limit — for enforced or otherwise late settlements).
bank.split_none: No combination of a single client's invoices matches the payment amount.
bank.split_reconcile_hint: Invoice is already paid — matching only links its existing payment to this transaction (no new payment is created).
bank.split_anchor_placeholder: Pick an invoice and find the rest…
bank.split_anchor_active: Showing combinations that include the selected invoice. Clear the selection for all suggestions.
bank.vs_hint: If the transaction has a VS, it's prefilled. You can edit it (e.g. when the client entered the wrong VS).
bank.import_duplicate: This statement has already been imported (statement #{id}).

templates.title: Rule templates
templates.applied: The template was applied and the rule is ready.

analytics.explainer_body: Accounts are detected from statements and settings. Every bank account has its own 221xxx sub-account (221100, 221200 …) assigned automatically; you can override it, for example to map an account onto a sub-account you already keep in the chart. The journal, balance sheet and stocktaking then break cash down per account.
analytics.empty: No bank accounts detected yet — they appear after the first statement import.
analytics.suffix_invalid: The analytic code for account {account} must be 1–6 digits.
analytics.suffix_required: The sub-account of {account} cannot be removed — it can only be changed to a different number.

posting.unposted_hint: All actual bank transactions without an active journal entry, including transactions for which no posting suggestion was created.
posting.all_hint: All bank transactions across every account and year, posted and unposted alike.
posting.search_placeholder: Search counterparty, VS, account number, description or amount…
posting.foreign_hint: Foreign-currency transaction — the amount is converted at the CNB rate of the payment date; the original currency and rate are stored with the entry.
posting.split_off: Back to a simple debit/credit pair
posting.split_bank_mismatch: Movement on account 221 ({got}) does not match the statement amount ({want}).
posting.split_ok: Entry is balanced and matches the statement.
posting.skipped_fx_hint: Foreign-currency payments are not posted yet (realized FX differences pending).
posting.create_rule_checkbox: Create a rule from this payment
posting.rule_message_hint: Matched against the movement description and the counterparty name.
posting.rule_priority_hint: Lower = higher precedence; below 50 overrides built-in detection
posting.rule_currency_hint: For currencies other than CZK, rules can only post to P&L accounts 5xx/6xx
posting.mode_hint: Auto-posts only on an unambiguous match; requires an amount range and at least one successful hit.
posting.mode_suggest_only_hint: A new rule always only suggests. Switch it to automatic posting after its first successful hit.
posting.saldo_hint: Invoice payments are matched, not posted by rules.
posting.saldo_manual_hint: Prefer matching an invoice payment to its document. Use a receivable/payable account (311, 321…) here only where matching is not an option.
posting.bank_analytic_hint: A bare 221 is posted to the analytic account of this statement's own bank account.
posting.dry_run_own_transfer_shadowed: This counter-account belongs to the same company. Own-transfer detection therefore handles these transactions before this rule; its usage count and promotion streak do not increase. Set the mode in Accounting automation.
posting.dry_run_zero: The rule matches no historical transaction — check the pattern.
posting.hint_title: Similar payment repeats ({count}× in the last year)
posting.suggestions_empty: No posting suggestions. Suggestions are created automatically from rules on statement import.
posting.rule_disabled_toast: The rule was rejected repeatedly and deactivated.
posting.reason_fx_not_supported: foreign currency (FX differences not supported yet)
posting.reason_document_not_posted: the invoice entry is not posted
posting.reason_not_double_entry: the company does not use double-entry accounting
posting.reason_already_paid_verify: the transaction is matched, but the invoice's earlier payment cannot be linked safely — check for a duplicate

dashboard.title: Dashboard

no_supplier.title: Create your supplier
no_supplier.intro: Before you can issue invoices and add clients, you need to create a supplier — your company whose details appear on documents. You skipped this step during the initial setup.
no_supplier.non_admin: Please ask your administrator to create a supplier in Settings → Codebooks → Suppliers.

onboarding.title: Welcome to MyÚčto.cz
onboarding.intro: Before you issue the first invoice, walk through a few settings so your documents match your company, tax regime and bank from day one. Open each step from its link and tick it off yourself; the guide can be hidden any time.
onboarding.hidden_note: The first-run setup guide is hidden.
onboarding.progress_hint: Tick the steps off yourself as you finish them.
onboarding.progress_all_done: All done — you can hide the guide.
onboarding.footnote: The guide shows until there are documents in the system. Ticking a step is your own note — the application neither changes nor verifies anything by it.

company.title: Company details
company.text: Name, registration number, VAT ID, address and contact. They print on every invoice and feed the tax reports, so start here.

taxes.title: Tax and accounting
taxes.text: Taxpayer type, VAT registration and filing period, tax evidence or double-entry bookkeeping. Taxes and reports follow this setting.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.text: The accounts your payments arrive on. The account number prints on invoices and drives payment matching from statements.

branding.title: Invoice look and logo
branding.text: Upload a logo, pick an accent colour and a document footer. Multiple profiles are fine if you invoice under several brands.

suppliers.title: Add more companies
suppliers.text: Your licence covers several companies. Each keeps its own documents, number series and reports; you switch between them in the header.

numbering.title: Numbering and documents
numbering.text: Number formats for invoices, proformas and credit notes, plus default due date and currency. Set it before the first document.

series.title: Journal document series
series.text: Accounting document series for the journal — prefix and numbering separately for invoices, bank, cash and internal documents.

bank_email.title: Payment notices from e-mail
bank_email.text: Connect the mailbox your bank sends payment notices to. MyÚčto matches invoice payments from them, even between statements.

databox.title: Data box
databox.text: The connection for payroll filings sent through the data box: health insurer overviews and notifications and the employer's monthly report to the social security administration (JMHZ). Tax returns and statements go through EPO instead.

ai_extraction.title: AI document extraction
ai_extraction.text: Your own Anthropic Claude key, which the application uses to read line items out of a received PDF invoice when there is no ISDOC. You pay the provider directly per use; without a key, documents are entered by hand.

users.title: Users and roles
users.text: Invite colleagues or your accountant. The role decides what each of them sees and may change.

client.title: Add your first client
client.text: Just enter the registration number — the address and the rest are pulled from the public register.

invoice.title: Issue your first invoice
invoice.text: Pick a client, add items and you are done. Numbers, VAT and reports are calculated for you.

dashboard.empty_hint: The dashboard fills up as soon as there is data. Start with your first client and issue an invoice — the figures, charts and tax reports follow on their own.

work_reports.title: Work reports
work_reports.hint: (draft issued invoices in progress — fill in and issue)

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Details and default behavior of the current company.

automation.title: Posting automation
automation.hint: Choose which operation types are disabled, suggested, or posted automatically.
automation.preset_off_hint: Automation does not create or post suggestions.
automation.preset_suggest_hint: Every recognized operation waits for your approval.
automation.preset_assisted_hint: Unambiguous payments and transfers post automatically; the rest remain suggestions.
automation.preset_full_hint: Deterministic operations post automatically; uncertain and AI suggestions always require approval.
automation.daily_limit_hint: Leave empty for no daily limit.

settings.is_identified_hint: A domestic non-payer with cross-border obligations: invoices for services to the EU are issued under reverse charge (Art. 196 of the VAT Directive) and included in the EC Sales List; VAT on received foreign supplies is self-assessed without the right to deduct (a VAT return of the “identified person” type is filed only for months when an obligation arose). Nothing changes domestically — you invoice without VAT.

vat_status.title: VAT payer status
vat_status.hint: VAT payer status changes are tracked over time — each change applies from its effective date (which may be in the future; it is applied on the effective day). Changes are saved immediately, without the Save button.
vat_status.form_date_locked_hint: The date of an existing row cannot be changed — delete the row and add a new one.
vat_status.delete_confirm_text: Really delete the change effective {date} ({state})? The status for earlier dates will revert to the previous history row.
vat_status.conflict_text: The effective date falls into a locked period or before already filed returns:
vat_status.conflict_hint: Continuing will save the change despite the listed conflicts and record your confirmation in the audit log. Already filed returns are not recalculated — any corrective/supplementary return is up to you.
vat_status.collision_locked_period: The date falls into a locked accounting period (status: {status}).
vat_status.collision_date_lock: Posting is locked until {date} (posting date lock).
vat_status.s6_banner_title: Turnover exceeded the VAT registration threshold (§ 6 VAT Act)
vat_status.s6_banner_text: Turnover of {turnover} exceeded the {limit} threshold — the company becomes a VAT payer by law on {date}. Record the change in the VAT status history so documents from that date are issued with VAT.
vat_status.s6_deadline_statutory: The registration application must be filed by {deadline} (§ 94(1) VAT Act — 10 working days from the day the turnover was exceeded).
vat_status.s6_deadline_informative: Informative date {deadline} (first day as a VAT payer). The application is due within 10 working days from the day the turnover was exceeded (§ 94(1) VAT Act) — the exact crossing day is not determined for the annual threshold.
vat_status.s79_prompt_registration: Registration effective {date} may entitle you to deduct VAT on business assets acquired before registration (§ 79). Items are recorded in the VAT corrections agenda.
vat_status.s79_prompt_deregistration: Deregistration effective {date} requires reducing the VAT deduction claimed on business assets (§ 79a). Items are recorded in the VAT corrections agenda.

settings.commercial_register_placeholder: Spisová značka X 12345 vedená u Krajského soudu v Plzni
settings.commercial_register_hint: Centered in the footer of every invoice PDF.
settings.commercial_register_loaded: Commercial register entry loaded from ARES.
settings.commercial_register_not_found: ARES returned no commercial register entry (legal entities only).
settings.commercial_register_none_fo: A sole proprietor has no commercial register entry.
settings.default_due_month_hint: Calendar month — Feb 1 → Mar 1, Jan 31 → Feb 28 (not a fixed 30 days).
settings.default_prices_include_vat: New invoices use prices incl. VAT
settings.default_prices_include_vat_hint: Pre-checks the “Item prices include VAT” mode on new invoices (B2C/receipts). Can be overridden per invoice.
settings.auto_send_reminders_hint: When off, the cron will not send automatic reminders for this supplier. Manual send (single + bulk) always works.
settings.reminder_days_after_due: Days after due date to send the first reminder
settings.reminder_days_after_due_hint: The cron sends the first reminder once the invoice is this many days past due. Applies to automatic reminders only; manual send always works.
settings.payment_thanks_enabled_hint: After an invoice is marked as paid, a short thank-you e-mail can be sent to the customer. Default: off.
settings.payment_thanks_default_checked: Pre-check when marking as paid manually

self_copy.title: Copies of outgoing e-mails to the supplier address
self_copy.hint: Messages to clients (documents, reminders, report approvals) are also copied to {email} — an audit trail of your own mail. “Per configuration” inherits the global cfg.php setting.
self_copy.approvals_note: The report approvals choice applies to both the approval request and approval reminders.

settings.auto_generate_recurring_hint: When off, the cron skips all recurring invoice templates for this supplier. Manual "Generate now" still works.
settings.embed_isdoc: Embed ISDOC XML in invoice PDFs
settings.embed_isdoc_hint: Machine-readable invoice data (ISDOC 6.0.2) is attached to the PDF. Czech accounting software (Pohoda, Money S3, …) extracts it automatically; Adobe Reader / Foxit show a paperclip icon below the variable symbol. Only applies to CZK invoices with an assigned variable symbol.
settings.proforma_payment_document: After a proforma is paid, issue
settings.proforma_payment_document_final: A final invoice once the advance is paid in full
settings.proforma_payment_document_tax: Always a tax document for the payment received (recommended)
settings.proforma_payment_document_manual: Nothing — I will issue the document myself
settings.proforma_payment_document_hint: A tax document for the payment received is the default because it is correct unconditionally: the duty to declare VAT arises on the day the payment is received, and so does the duty to issue a document. Choose the final invoice only when the supply happens on payment (fast sales, same-day shipping or service) — otherwise the document claims a supply that has not happened and makes the customer's VAT deduction harder to prove. The "Nothing" option creates no draft; paid advances without a document are then listed in the daily tasks, because the document is due within 15 days.
settings.signing_subtitle: Electronically sign PDF of issued invoices and work reports with a certificate (PAdES). Recipients can verify the document was not altered after issuance.
settings.signing_cert_hint: Upload a P12/PFX certificate including the private key. The password is stored encrypted, the file outside the public web root.
settings.signing_need_cert: Upload a certificate below first — then you can enable signing.
settings.signing_cert_remove_confirm: Really remove the signing certificate? Invoices will no longer be signed.
settings.signing_tsa_url_required: Enter the TSA URL for timestamping.
settings.signing_tsa_hint: RFC 3161 TSA server URL for PAdES-T (trusted timestamp). Empty = signature without timestamp (PAdES-B).
settings.signing_tsa_auth_hint: TSA login (only if the server requires it) — HTTP Basic auth.
settings.signing_profiles_hint: Profiles prepare the shared layer for PDF signatures and future outgoing e-mail signing.
settings.signing_profiles_accountant_enabled: Allow users to manage their own signing profiles
settings.signing_profiles_accountant_hint: Users will only be able to edit profiles they own.
settings.signing_profiles_empty: No signing profile has been created yet.
settings.signing_profiles_load_failed: Signing profiles could not be loaded.
settings.signing_profile_usage_required: Select at least one profile usage.
settings.signing_profile_cert_upload_after_create: The certificate will be uploaded automatically after the new profile is saved.
settings.signing_profile_cert_file_password_requi: Select a certificate file and enter its password.
settings.signing_profile_cert_prompt_on_use_hint: Ask on use is disabled for now. Choose encrypted storage or passphrase file before saving the profile.
settings.signing_profile_cert_passphrase_profile_: Enter the passphrase file profile ID.
settings.signing_profile_cert_password_required_f: Enter the certificate password to store it in the app.
settings.signing_profile_cert_delete_confirm: Really remove the certificate from this profile?
settings.certificate_vault_hint: The single place where a certificate is uploaded. PDF signatures, encrypted S/MIME e-mail, EPO tax submissions and payroll submissions all read it from here — no need to upload it in several places.
settings.certificate_vault_security: The PFX/P12 file and its password are stored encrypted with a dedicated application key. The private key never returns to the browser or to the log, so every operation with it requires fresh verification.
settings.certificate_vault_grant_hint: Which certificate a given company may use is granted in tax submissions.
settings.certificate_vault_upload_hint: A PFX/P12 file with the private key. The file password is not your MyÚčto password — it is the password protecting the certificate itself.
settings.certificate_vault_step_up_hint: The verification covers this single upload and is never stored.
settings.certificate_vault_step_up_password_missi: Enter your MyÚčto password to store the certificate.
settings.certificate_vault_step_up_totp_missing: Enter the six-digit authenticator code to store the certificate.
settings.certificate_vault_passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys, verify with your password.
settings.signing_upload_separate: Upload a file into this profile only
settings.signing_upload_legacy_hint: Legacy path: the file is stored on the server disk outside the shared Certificates and applies to this profile only. Use it only where a certificate from the Certificates section cannot be used.
settings.signing_vault_empty_hint: No valid certificate is enabled for this company yet. Upload it in the Certificates section and enable it in tax submissions.
settings.signing_vault_hint: The private key remains in the encrypted vault, so the same certificate can be used for PDF, S/MIME and EPO without uploading it again.
settings.signing_vault_personal_profile_required: A personal certificate can only be linked to your own signing profile.
settings.signing_vault_password_required: Enter your current MyÚčto password to link the personal certificate.
settings.signing_vault_totp_required: Enter your TOTP code to link the personal certificate.
settings.signing_profile_pdf_settings_hint: TSA and TSA credentials belong to the profile. Without TSA the signature uses PAdES-B. An empty signing reason uses the default text for the document type.
settings.signing_outputs_hint: This setting controls which signing profile is used for PDF and e-mail output types.
settings.signing_output_user_profiles_inactive: User-owned profiles are not used for this output.
settings.signing_output_identity_same_domain_hint: When addresses differ, From is changed to the certificate e-mail only if the original From uses the same domain.
settings.signing_output_identity_allowlist_hint: One item per line: exact e-mail or domain. On match, From is changed to the certificate e-mail.

settings.email_profiles_global_fallback: When no active default profile exists, the app uses the global SMTP configuration from cfg.php and Reply-To from the supplier e-mail.

settings.branding_subtitle: Custom logo and colors in the header of outgoing emails AND on invoice PDFs. When disabled, e-mails use the default MyÚčto „M" branding and PDFs show the company name as text.
settings.branding_logo_hint: PNG / JPG / SVG (max 1 MiB, ideally under 200 KiB). For raster: ideal height 240 px (renders in email at 48 px on 5× retina). SVG: original is kept for PDF (vector = crisp at any zoom), e-mail uses the converted transparent PNG (Outlook/Gmail strip SVG).
settings.branding_logo_show_name: Show company name next to logo (in PDF)
settings.branding_logo_show_name_hint: By default the invoice PDF shows the logo only. Enable this if the logo is small or has no name — the trade (or company) name will then be rendered next to the logo. Applies to the PDF only; e-mails always show the name next to the logo.
settings.branding_accent_color_hint: Color of the „M" logo (if you have no custom logo) and of links in the email. Default #3B2D83 (MyÚčto purple).

When branding is enabled, the same logo is used on invoice PDFs — when disabled, PDFs show the company name as text.
settings.currency_active_hint: Active (can be used for new invoices)

sample_data.title: Sample data
sample_data.description: The system contains generated sample (demo) data. You can remove it in one step and start fresh with your own data. Your own records are kept.
sample_data.confirm_text: All generated sample data (clients, documents, logbook…) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. Your own records are kept.

settings.numbering_hint_intro: Custom invoice number format — leave empty to use the global cfg.php template. Placeholders:
settings.invoice_number_format_hint: Template must contain a counter (C in curly braces).
settings.invoice_number_period_hint: When the counter resets back to 1.
settings.purchase_invoice_number_format_hint: Internal number of received invoices. {PP} = tax-type prefix (PF/PN/KU/KN/NU/NN). Empty = default {PP}{YY}{MM}{CCC} (e.g. PF2605001); for the legacy format use PF-{YYYY}{MM}-{CCCC} (e.g. PF-202605-0001).
settings.numbering_must_have_counter: Missing counter — add e.g. CCC in curly braces.
settings.numbering_collision_warning: Number series collision — after stripping non-digit characters (letters, dashes, slashes) these produce the same variable symbol:
settings.numbering_collision_hint: A bank payment with this VS would then match ambiguously (or accidentally match the wrong document). Adjust the templates to differ by a digit (e.g. a different leading digit), not just a letter — matching normalizes letters away.
settings.tax_hint: Fields needed for XML report generation (DPHDP3, Kontrolní hlášení). Optional otherwise.

accounting_enabled.title: Keep accounting records

accounting_enabled.hint: Enables the journal, general ledger, statements, assets and year-end closing — and in tax evidence mode the cash journal and the receivables/payables overview. Turning it off hides them from the menu; invoicing, clients, bank, VAT returns and control statements keep working. The number of licensed companies and users does not change with this switch.

payroll_enabled.title: Run payroll
payroll_enabled.label: Run payroll
payroll_enabled.hint: Enables the standalone payroll module for this company in either accounting mode. It is disabled by default.
payroll_enabled.alpha_warning: The payroll module is still a TESTING ALPHA and is by no means suitable for production use. Do not rely on its pay, contribution or filing calculations for social security, health insurance or the tax office — verify them against another source.
payroll_enabled.off_note: Payroll disappears from the menu after saving. Payroll data is not deleted and remains available when enabled again.

settings.accounting_mode_hint: Double-entry accounting activates the accounting modules (journal, general ledger). settings.accounting_mode_switch_confirm: Switching to double-entry accounting will seed the chart of accounts, but {total} historical documents (cash: {cash}, sales invoices: {invoices}, purchase invoices: {purchase_invoices}) will remain WITHOUT a journal entry. settings.auto_post_invoices_hint: Post an invoice to the journal right after it is issued. A posting error won't block issuing — the invoice stays issued and you post it manually.
settings.auto_post_purchases_hint: Post a received invoice to the journal right after it is received. A posting error won't block it — you post the invoice manually.
settings.vat_period_hint: VAT control statement is always monthly, even for quarterly VAT payers.
settings.flat_tax_hint: Non-VAT payers only (§ 7a Income Tax Act). The Sales page shows how close you are to the band's income limit.
settings.financial_office_hint: e.g. 451 = Prague 1. Find on tax portal.

settings.cz_nace_hint: Code from the CZ-NACE codebook (e.g. 62.09.00). Type a number or activity name.
settings.data_box_type_hint: ISDS mailbox kind. Unrelated to the taxpayer type — has no effect on tax filings.
settings.street_number_hint: If empty, parsed automatically from the Street field.

settings.sest_hint: Optional — if accountant/advisor prepares the report.
settings.pohoda_hint: Codes from Pohoda's enums (account, centre, activity, contract, accounting entry). Fill only if you want them auto-applied to all exported invoices. If empty, Pohoda will use its own defaults after import.

settings.cz_nace_expired: Code {code} expired on {date} (the codebook moved to NACE rev. 2.1). Filing still goes through, but the portal will flag it — please pick a successor.
settings.cz_nace_unknown: Code {code} is not in the current codebook. Filing still goes through, but the portal will flag it.

licensed_modules.title: Licensed modules

oss_rates.hint: VAT rates of EU member states used to verify OSS documents. This is a control codebook, not the rates used on documents — those live under VAT rates.

cron_jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
cron_jobs.subtitle: What should run automatically and when it last ran. The app cannot read crontab / Task Scheduler directly — every cron script writes its own heartbeat, and if the last successful run is missing or too old, you'll see a warning.
cron_jobs.tooltip_overdue: Last successful run is older than {hours} h.
cron_jobs.tooltip_failing: The last run ended with an error.
cron_jobs.tooltip_never_ran: Script never ran — most likely it isn't scheduled in crontab / Task Scheduler.
cron_jobs.tooltip_idle: This job only runs when there is work to do, and right now there isn't — that's why the last run is ageing. {script} is what proves scheduling still works.
cron_jobs.tooltip_pending: The installation is new and this job hasn't had a full period ({hours} h) yet — not a problem for now.
cron_jobs.tooltip_disabled: The installation's configuration (cron.disabled_jobs) disabled this job — it won't run until the admin/operator re-enables it. Not a malfunction.
cron_jobs.setup_hint: Cron setup: see {link} in the manual.
cron_jobs.all_ok: All scheduled jobs are running on time.
cron_jobs.setup_paths_hint: this server's paths — ready to copy
cron_jobs.setup_intro_linux: Add to the crontab of a user allowed to write into log/ and storage/. The .sh wrappers locate the project root themselves and redirect output to a daily log.
cron_jobs.setup_intro_windows: Run from an elevated command prompt. Change /ru SYSTEM if the tasks must run under a service account with access to network drives.
cron_jobs.setup_intro_docker: In the Docker image cron is generated from the catalog at build time — nothing is scheduled by hand, only verified.
cron_jobs.setup_foreign_platform: This server runs on a different platform — the paths below are examples, adjust them for the target machine.
cron_jobs.setup_note: Frequencies come from the job catalog (CronCatalog) — the same ones shown on the cards above. After scheduling, verify that the log directory is being written to and watch the status on this page.
cron_jobs.run_now_confirm: Really run script {script} now? It will run in the background and the result will appear in the table when it finishes.
cron_jobs.run_now_started: Script {script} has been started in the background.
cron_jobs.mode_subtitle: Controls who launches the jobs. What the individual jobs do does not change — only how many entries have to be scheduled.
cron_jobs.mode_managed: Job scheduling is run by us — the mode cannot be switched on a managed installation. If jobs stop running, please contact support.
cron_jobs.mode_individual_desc: Every job is its own crontab / Task Scheduler entry ({count} entries). Transparent and debuggable one job at a time — a failure of one does not affect the others.
cron_jobs.mode_dispatcher_desc: A single entry is scheduled ({script}, every minute) that works out what is due, skips jobs with nothing to do and launches the rest as separate processes. One entry instead of {count} — the trade-off is that its failure stops every job.
cron_jobs.mode_confirm: Switch scheduling mode to “{mode}”? Switching alone does not change the schedule — the crontab / Task Scheduler has to be regenerated (restart the container on Docker).

submissions.title: EPO filing & archive
submissions.subtitle: Hand generated XML over to the EPO form, complete the filing on the Financial Administration portal, and store the confirmation and readable copy in an evidence archive.
submissions.empty: No records match the filter. The first XML appears here after a tax report is generated.
submissions.delete_confirm: Delete this XML snapshot? Proof of an actually filed submission cannot be deleted.
submissions.settings_hint: Choose root folders in Documents. MyÚčto creates the year, period and form type below them automatically.
submissions.vat_root_hint: Root for VAT, control, recapitulative and OSS returns.
submissions.income_root_hint: Root for personal and corporate income tax returns.
submissions.assisted_title: Assisted filing: MyÚčto prepares, the user submits
submissions.assisted_hint: MyÚčto sends the exact archived XML to the supported EPO form. You complete checks, authentication and final submission on the portal, then drop the P7S confirmation and optional PDF copy back here.
submissions.test_mode_hint: The test=1 parameter requires a ZAREP-signed submission, so it is not used in this unsigned flow. Invalid XSD is blocked locally and the EPO form shows further problems before submission.
submissions.search_placeholder: Search form, period, filing number or hash…
submissions.popup_blocked: The browser blocked the new window. Use Continue to EPO in the detail panel.
submissions.handoff_created: The EPO form is ready and opened in a new window. You can return to it for about 20 minutes, as long as the underlying data does not change.
submissions.handoff_window: The link is single-use — the portal consumes it the first time it is opened. It is also usable only for about 20 minutes after creation and only while the underlying data stays unchanged. The portal never tells us how long the link really lives.
submissions.handoff_stale_title: The link is no longer offered
submissions.handoff_stale_hint: The link has already been opened (it is single-use and the portal then reports that the filing does not exist), or the roughly 20-minute window has passed, or the XML has been recalculated in the meantime. If you did not finish the filing, create a new link — it is cheap and always works.
submissions.moss_oss_title: The OSS return is filed in the MOSS/OSS application
submissions.moss_oss_hint: It cannot be filed through the general EPO route — neither by handing the XML over to the web form nor by a direct ZAREP filing: the portal does recognise the document, but rejects it because you must be signed in to the MOSS/OSS application. That is why no filing route is offered here. Download the XML and upload it in the MOSS/OSS application on the Czech tax portal (a separate item in the top bar next to EPO), which requires its own sign-in.
submissions.preflight_failed: The XML cannot be handed to EPO until it passes XSD validation
submissions.upload_hint: Drop the P7S confirmation and PDF copy here. MyÚčto creates the target folder first, stores the exact source XML in it and links every file to this submission.
submissions.drop_files: Drop files here or click to select
submissions.upload_partial: Some files could not be uploaded: {count}.
submissions.marked_submitted: The snapshot was manually marked as submitted.
submissions.vat_clearing_skipped: Filing recorded, but the VAT clearing entry (343) was not posted: {reason}. The tax difference is missing from the ledger — check the period lock and run the clearing again.
submissions.state_password_hint: Together with the reference number it retrieves the filing and its copy on the tax portal.
submissions.state_password_reveal_note: EPO issued this password in the receipt. Revealing it requires verification and is recorded in the audit log.
submissions.no_artifacts: No files stored yet. The source XML is saved automatically on the first handoff or upload.
submissions.artifact_submission_signer_cert: Certificate used to sign the filing
submissions.verify_problem_signature: The cryptographic signature could not be verified.
submissions.verify_problem_chain: The signature is cryptographically valid, but its certificate chain is not trusted. The filing was not confirmed automatically.
submissions.verify_problem_signer: The EPO seal identity cannot yet be checked against a managed Financial Administration allowlist. Review the receipt and record the filing manually.
submissions.verify_problem_format: The file does not contain a recognized EPO confirmation structure.
submissions.verify_problem_form: The confirmation belongs to a different form type.
submissions.verify_problem_form_unknown: The form type cannot be determined reliably from the confirmation.
submissions.verify_problem_content: The confirmation content does not match the archived XML snapshot.
submissions.verify_problem_xml_mismatch: The uploaded XML does not match the archived snapshot.
submissions.verify_problem_xml_diff: The uploaded XML differs from the archived snapshot in {count} values — the archive no longer matches what was filed.
submissions.verify_problem_xml_other_form: The uploaded XML is a different form ({form}) — it belongs to another submission.
submissions.pdf_hint_reference: Filing number {reference} was read from the printout.
submissions.prefilled_from_receipt: Pre-filled from the EPO receipt — both the filing number and the time come from the signed confirmation.
submissions.prefilled_from_pdf: Pre-filled from the PDF printout. That is extracted text, not signed proof — verify the values against the receipt.
submissions.state_password_stored: The status-query password was taken from the receipt — “Refresh status” is now available.
submissions.no_attempts: The XML has not yet been handed to EPO.
submissions.manual_fallback_hint: Use this after reviewing the P7S or another receipt. The system checks available technical properties, but does not change filing status automatically without a verified EPO seal allowlist.
submissions.direct_title: Direct EPO API: full test first, deliberate submission second
submissions.direct_hint: MyÚčto signs the immutable XML snapshot with your qualified certificate, sends it with test=1 and displays every EPO validation message. Live submission is enabled only after a successful test.
submissions.direct_hint_sandbox: MyÚčto exclusively uses the MOJE daně sandbox. It first validates with test=1 and then enables a complete sandbox filing with no effect on production.
submissions.direct_hint_unknown: The EPO environment could not be determined safely. Submission actions are disabled until the configuration can be loaded.
submissions.direct_reason_readonly: You are not allowed to file for this company. Ask for a role with write permission.
submissions.direct_reason_moss_oss: An OSS return cannot be filed through the direct EPO API. Download the XML and upload it in the MOSS/OSS application on the tax portal.
submissions.direct_reason_no_credential: No signing certificate is selected. Upload and enable a ZAREP certificate for this company first.
submissions.direct_reason_validation: The XML failed local XSD validation. Fix the data and regenerate the snapshot first.
submissions.direct_reason_already_submitted: This XML snapshot has already been filed. Submitting again would create a duplicate.
submissions.direct_reason_unresolved: A previous direct attempt has an unresolved outcome. Refresh or resolve its status in the “…” menu first.
submissions.direct_reason_test_missing: Run “Test in EPO” first — live submission unlocks only after a successful test.
submissions.direct_reason_test_required: The latest direct attempt is in state “{status}”. Live submission unlocks only after a successful EPO test.
submissions.direct_reason_handoff_active: After the successful test you started an assisted EPO handoff (state “{status}”, link valid until {until}). Finish it or wait for the link to expire — otherwise you risk filing twice.
submissions.assisted_alternative: Assisted opening always uses the live interactive MOJE daně form and does not submit anything by itself. Manual receipt upload remains a separate alternative.
submissions.epo_test_environment_title: Direct EPO is using the sandbox environment
submissions.epo_test_environment_hint: Signed direct operations use zkus.mojedane.gov.cz and do not mark the snapshot as a real filing. Assisted opening uses the live interactive form but does not submit anything by itself.
submissions.epo_environment_unknown_title: The EPO environment cannot be verified
submissions.epo_environment_unknown_hint: Live filing is therefore not shown as available. Refresh the page or check access to the EPO configuration.
submissions.recover_confirmation_title: Recover filing from an EPO confirmation
submissions.recover_confirmation_hint: Upload the original P7S/P7M receipt. The application verifies the EPO signature, trusted chain and its binding to the exact submitted CMS package.
submissions.confirmation_recovered: The confirmation was verified and the filing state was completed.
submissions.delete_confirm_unresolved: This snapshot has an EPO handoff whose outcome the application cannot know — it has no way to tell whether you filed it in the portal. If you did not file it, you can delete it. The deletion is recorded in the audit trail.
submissions.delete_blocked_submitted: The snapshot is marked as filed — it is evidence for the tax authority and cannot be deleted.
submissions.delete_blocked_delivered: EPO provably accepted the filing (confirmed attempt, filing number or receipt). Legal evidence of a filing must not be deleted.
submissions.resolve_not_submitted_hint: Use only when the attempt has no filing number or status password and you verified directly in EPO that no filing was created.
submissions.resolve_not_submitted_warning: Releasing the attempt enables another live submission of the same XML. An incorrect confirmation may cause a duplicate tax filing.
submissions.resolution_note: How and where you verified that no filing was created
submissions.resolve_not_submitted_check: I confirm that I checked directly in EPO and the filing was not received.
submissions.attempt_released: The attempt was audit-closed as not received.
submissions.direct_panel_hint: The test checks the signature, structure and business rules without filing anything. A separate password confirmation performs the legally effective submission.
